programme.title: 荒江女俠
programme.desc: 鐵臂金剛方甯、方靜押送賑銀救濟黃河災民,途中受到盜寇的突襲,全家老少遭殺害,惟稚女方瑛琪為玄真道長救出,抱入深山撫養瑛琪長成後,盡得玄真道長武功真傳其時金兵圖大舉進犯中原,玄真道長授瑛琪一劍一信,著其下山投效義軍首領夏子龍

programme.title: 藍與黑續集
programme.desc: 劇情承接上集,唐琪結束夜總會歌女生涯,在戰亂中跑遍中國尋找愛人張醒亞,但醒亞卻糾纏於日軍,叛亂分子及將軍的美麗女兒當中

programme.title: 報仇
programme.desc: 玉樓發現武館師傅封與妻子有著曖昧情愫後,最後更被傅封所殺玉樓的弟弟小樓得悉兄長被殺後,誓要為兄報仇

programme.title: 玉女嬉春
programme.desc: 呂紫英陪同父呂天奇到台灣發展,兩姐白虹、青萍留港繼續歌舞生涯白虹認識江慶良後投契相戀,江向老闆引薦白虹在歌劇中當主角,老父回來見三位女兒成就,開心不已

programme.title: 武林風雲
programme.desc: 故事描述,武義親王恃勢弄權,為奪紫光劍,不惜害死甘大雄、迫走徐牧,並命其子魯天霞率惡家奴直闖甘家堡,借弔祭為名,實以武力奪劍甘氏三女勝男、亞男、超男惶然之際,表親徐進到訪,聯手殺退惡奴,但大戰中,徐進、勝男等受傷,無恙的亞男遂往飛虎嶺邀救兵……

programme.title: 阿牛發達記
programme.desc: 阿牛拾得一袋珠寶,從此富貴這時,周大叔假意叫他簽約迎娶一名女子,却原來是個陷阱,為的是要賣掉他的房子最後,可憐的阿牛又回復一貧如洗…

programme.title: 中國超人
programme.desc: 太空科學研究深所獲悉有來自冰河時代的人類所化之怪物將會危及地球上的所有人類這批怪物兇悍異常,神通廣大,大有霸佔整個世界的野心為了對付這批怪物,科學研究所所長劉英德以自己數十年來的研究心得把勇敢的科學研究員雷馬製造成萬能超人中國超人開始了與怪物的戰鬥……

programme.title: 天使出更
programme.desc: 話說醫務署發覺聖慕倫醫院的醫療水準及設備大有問題,原來該院院長體弱多病,院務交陳醫生主理;但陳個性主觀,行事不依規章,連手下一班見習醫生亦各具「特性」,時鬧笑話,弄至院務混亂院長決定聘用資深護士長進行改革

programme.title: 大殺四方
programme.desc: 故事描述,民初北方軍閥混戰,民不聊生,紛紛向南逃難,三位青年王緒、金正平和魚漢生,夾在難民群中,來到戰區邊沿王因出手營救一女難民,致遭地方民團首領陳祖光的手下追捕,幸得風塵女子紅菱所救……

programme.title: 噴火美人魚
programme.desc: 三對年青男女出海渡假,忽然聽到新聞報導:一個穿紅色比堅尼泳衣的女郎一連殺了十三人,並正駕駛著快艇逃亡正在此時,一個美的女郎破浪而來,身穿紅色比堅尼女郎要求跟他們同上島避風當晚,女郎的挑逗令眾男女之間產生前所未有的衝突 電影未到最後一分鐘,不知結局

programme.title: 目無王法
programme.desc: 何中衡、秦英豪及羅正三個初出茅廬的捕快,秉除暴安良,維護法紀之宗旨,盡力撲滅罪行,縣中賭館妓院,均遭掃蕩三人因堅拒與貪贓枉法的縣官與捕頭同流合污,而慘被陷害

programme.title: 鬼馬神偷
programme.desc: 魯俊谷、張權、於洋三人乃沙煲兄弟,三人合力獲得寶物「雙面神」,不料卻給胡起尾注,將三人毒殺,獨吞「雙面神」劉永、梁家仁及梁韻蕊是他們的後人,在不打不相識之下重逢,為了完成亡父的遺志,三人齊心向胡偷回寶物韻蕊早已混入胡家中,色誘胡之子,作為內應查出「雙面神」之收藏地點永與家仁則扮鬼扮馬,偷天換日

programme.title: 五郎八卦棍
programme.desc: 楊家將被敵軍突襲,幾近全軍覆沒,僅存兩名兒子生還楊家五子遂逃入少林寺,向少林僧人學習「狼牙棒法」,後來更創出「五郎八卦棍」最終,楊五郎與眾寺僧聯手,為楊家將報仇

programme.title: 奇門怪招爛頭蟀

programme.title: 瀛台泣血

programme.title: 瀛台泣血

programme.title: 龍虎鬥

programme.title: 阿牛入城記
programme.desc: 這部喜劇描述鄉下人阿牛來港後,因生性戇直而經常被壞人利用阿牛嘗盡低下層社會的人情冷暖,最後更被判入獄!究竟天生樂觀的他,能否吉人天相?

programme.title: 鐵羅漢
programme.desc: 追風刀劉鵬為采花大盜小天尊所殺,遺言徒弟盧漢去京師尋護龍刀復仇途上,盧助康氏姊妹玉笙與玉簫退敵;抵京後又路見不平,救韓五嫂一命,因而結識韓的女兒牡丹

programme.title: 茅山殭屍拳
programme.desc: 以「趕屍」為業的陳師父與徒弟受託押運九具殭屍,啟程上路未料途中兩具竟逃脫其中一具實際上並非殭屍,而是為躲避敵人追殺而假扮的江湖豪客更令人意外的是,此人與陳師父同樣身懷絕技,二人皆為深不可測的武林高手!

programme.title: 大地兒女
programme.desc: 這是一部經典戰爭鉅片,描述抗日戰爭時人民的生活狀況畫家俞瑞意外救了由鄉下被拐賣來的女子荷花兩人互生情愫,不久更結為夫妻過著幸福的日子無奈好景不常,不久日軍全面侵入中國,亦正式展開殘酷的統治…

programme.title: 不了情
programme.desc: 在這部浪漫愛情經典中,夜總會歌女李青青邂逅英俊青年湯鵬南,兩人漸生情愫,卻在感情路上經歷無數誤會、分離和折磨當他們終於重燃愛火時,青青卻得知一個噩耗,最終無奈迎來悲慘的結局

programme.title: 十二金錢鏢
programme.desc: 喬茂押鏢時,遇女贼袁玉蓉,舉刀要殺之際,卻被袁的美麗媚態吸引,後兩人互生愛慕,更發現憑獨門武器「十二金錢鏢」名震天下的俞劍平,與背後操控袁的老頭,有段血海深仇…

programme.title: 春暖花開
programme.desc: 故事描述,陳太太有女潔玉及美玉,潔玉已工作,美玉仍求學適逢陳家有空房出租,少奇來租,一談即合;潔玉三個姊姊,皆與租客結婚,所以潔玉表姊趙靜蘭之母決仿效陳家租房選婿未幾,一醫科學生欣農來租房,趙母見他是理想快婿,忙出租原來少奇與欣農是同學,少奇老成寡言,被潔玉、美玉視為怪人,欣農則只顧談戀愛…

programme.title: 仇連環
programme.desc: 仇連環在上海灘以拳頭打出天下,乃好勇鬥狠的典型人物仇為了交際花沈菊芳不惜豁出性命,與著名幫會首腦之子及同伴展開連場明爭暗鬥,亦成為幫會爭奪地盤的嫁禍目標

programme.title: 邪
programme.desc: 民國初年廣州西關的陳家大屋,家道中落只剩下陳秀英及其入贅之丈夫楊振宇秀英多病,而振宇又鬱鬱不得志,故常遭振宇辱打直至自稱陳家僕人之女梁綺華的出現,聯同秀英反抗,竟錯手將振宇殺死!秀英自始活在驚恐之中,最終被振宇的鬼魂嚇死!原來這只是振宇在與綺華合谋殺害秀英,就在振宇以為可與綺華共築愛巢之際,秀英

programme.title: 奪魂鈴

programme.title: 邪鬥邪
programme.desc: 餘腩沉溺賭海,由於欠債累累無力償還,遂答應債主以其妻肉償債項事件被其妻識破,並決意離餘而去餘動輕生念頭,可最終自殺未遂餘遇上一名富家老伯,老伯答應給餘巨額現金,只要餘答應幫他娶得美人歸

programme.title: 飛燕金刀
programme.desc: 總鏢頭李志山的妻子私通對頭人龍震天,並設計先偷飛龍刀,再殺害李志山及女兒小燕,幸好最後李氏父女成功逃脫小燕長大後,更成為武功高強的女劍客,誓要為死去的母親報仇直至一個偶然的機會,小燕遇到仍然在生的母親,才駭然發現真相,原來自己一直被父親的謊言所蒙騙

programme.title: 春火

programme.title: 獵人

programme.title: 少林傳人

programme.title: 射鵰英雄傳續集

programme.title: 保鏢

programme.title: 牛鬼蛇神

programme.title: 射鵰英雄傳

programme.title: 蝴蝶盃

programme.title: 群英會

programme.title: 鬼新娘
programme.desc: 方明在趕路途中邂逅神秘年輕女子冷秋屏,兩人情投意合並私訂終身婚後方明驚覺妻子竟是受邪靈操控、被迫吸取男子精氣的亡魂,但冷秋屏因真情不忍加害最終在道士相助下,方明擊敗邪靈救出愛妻,然而人鬼殊途,兩人於晨光中淒然訣別,冷秋屏含淚投胎轉世

programme.title: 插翅難飛
programme.desc: 鄧彪因為黑貨買賣失手,遂逼江湖人物高明供出從中陷害者,高明說出乃黑豹所為後,即被開槍殺死,鄧彪因此被判監禁十五年他出獄後即找黑豹報仇,卻遇上勢力龐大的葛八爺幹擾;同時商琳為尋失蹤十五年的丈夫,欲找鄧彪查問黑豹下落,但兩人僅聽過黑豹其名,從未見其人,究竟黑豹是誰?

programme.title: 慾燄狂流
programme.desc: 故事描述飾花花公子的喬莊與好友楊帆,同時愛上胡燕妮,但楊成人之美但喬因生殖力弱,故當胡懷孕時,就懷疑妻與楊有染…

programme.title: 來如風
programme.desc: 明皇身染惡疾,駕崩在即,卻無子可繼帝位;皇侄世子傑本可繼位,惜不成器,難當大任皇弟徽王想起明皇曾與東宮宮女生有子女各一,現時藏匿于東陽縣,遂命锦衣衛劉玄平尋找公主與王子的下落劉玄平路上屢遭世子傑爪牙追殺,幸得俠士來如風相助

programme.title: 楊乃武與小白菜
programme.desc: 劇情講述,知縣之子劉子和,垂涎葛小大之妻小白菜,用迷藥將其姦污劉子和事後恐東窗事發,用砒霜毒死葛小大葛死後,鎮內流言四起,知縣為救愛兒,設計嫁禍小白菜婚前戀人楊乃武乃武被苦打成招,其姊楊淑英不忍見弟含冤而死,到刑部要求翻案……

programme.title: 摩登澡堂
programme.desc: 從小與父親疏遠的鄭輝,意外穿越回了八十年代,在與年輕時的父親一同經歷了許多事後,慢慢走進了陌生父親的內心,明白了工作之間並無尊卑之分,每個普通人都有著平凡而偉大的夢想。

programme.title: 狼兵吼
programme.desc: 該片講述了抗日戰爭全面爆發後,滇軍中的大批文山兒女在抗日前線英勇殺敵,突破日軍的圍追堵截,將文山三七運送到前線為抗日將士止血療傷的故事。

programme.title: 挺進中原

programme.title: 百家拳之雄鷹
programme.desc: 陳子正少年成名,卻因交友不慎被人算計,武功盡廢被逐出師門,師妹也因此被害。流落江湖受盡人間冷暖,後得高人指點,傷癒後自創鷹爪翻子拳,在軍閥李景森籌辦的擂臺賽上為自己和師門討回了公道,終成一代宗師。

programme.title: 白衣俠女

programme.title: 廣東十虎黃澄可之雲起龍驤
programme.desc: 同治元年,廣州知府“柳承望查出“九王爺暗中支持蓮花教起義謀反。將九王爺謀反之事密奏廣州按察使“易瑾瑜,易瑾瑜為攀附九王爺出賣了柳承望。九王爺派出鷹犬司徒宇、左秋水密殺柳承望和他的家眷,幸得忠勇侍衛抵死保護,柳承望和愛女柳白凝才

programme.title: 反恐特戰隊之刺殺危機
programme.desc: 我方情報部門截獲情報,H國恐怖勢力黑日組織一號頭目山貓將要入境。武警反恐前敵指揮部指揮長少將常建安迅速集結武警神鷹和雪狼反恐特戰隊部署實施“剿貓行動。n老奸巨猾的山貓在即將進入中國國境之時,臨時改變路線,我方潛伏在恐怖組織內部的特勤人員颶

programme.title: 金婚
programme.desc: 影片以散文般的風格和結構把兩個老人的晚年生活娓娓道來,平淡中帶著無聊,含蓄中帶著無奈,如果沒有對婚姻與家庭的體驗恐怕難以對影片發出會心一笑或由衷的歎息。

programme.title: 青春逗
programme.desc: 東山大學“三劍客林漢傑、程銘、郝大雨,三位年輕人在離開大學進入社會的過程中,發生了一系列整蠱搞怪令人啼笑皆非的故事。家庭的突然破產令整蠱富二代林漢傑跌入穀底,畢業之後,所有人都找到了工作,只有林漢傑整日無所事事沒有方向。苦於無奈,林漢傑找

programme.title: 史前超人

programme.title: 非洲野狗:族群對獅群 #5
programme.desc: 目睹卡昆比族群將一隻跟蹤牠們的豹子趕到樹上,你會感到心跳加速加入朱爾茲的ZCP獅子項圈任務,與偵察員西蒙一起釣魚,探索野狗族群在進食期間的等級關係,並見證一場陪伴一隻受重傷卡昆比幼崽的令人心碎的守夜

programme.title: 生命之旅 #1 英普
programme.desc: 撐過嬰兒期是地球上幾乎所有物種的最大挑戰在非洲荒野,生死的平衡很容易傾側,動物必須成長並迅速學習,才能度過生命的第一階段

programme.title: 野小子 #1 英普
programme.desc: 在納米比亞中部,一群非洲野犬在乾旱的土地上漫遊受到獅子和乾旱兩面夾擊,一隻名為賴卡的勇敢幼崽必須快速成長,學習獵人的技能,並找到自己在族群中的定位

programme.title: 野小子 #2 英普
programme.desc: 在南非的大克魯格國家公園,一頭名為青加的幼崽出生在馬啦馬啦獅群這個獵人世家中在忠實的父親,嚴母和淘氣的姐姐指導下,青加找到她在族群中的定位

programme.title: 野小子 #3 英普
programme.desc: 小獵豹烏珊娜生長在不利環境中很少小獵豹能夠撐過一歲但她很幸運,有一位厲害的母親,她會不惜一切保護幼崽安全烏珊娜只需跟隨她的腳步

programme.title: 野小子 #4 英普
programme.desc: 在巴西卡皮瓦拉山脈國家公園裡,小卷尾猴施高正學習如何融入規則複雜的族群,並探索充滿刺激和危機處處的森林但純熟地掌控工具才是他的生存關鍵

programme.title: 野小子 #5 英普
programme.desc: 在印度,年幼獅尾猴華菲面對著不斷縮小的棲息地和人類世界的侵擾幸運的是,他有一位慈母,一位防範的父親,一位淘氣的姐姐,以及眾多親戚都在看顧他

programme.title: 潛鳥:迷霧中的吶喊
programme.desc: 與生物學家們一起爭分奪秒,試圖找出北美潛鳥突然瀕臨滅絕的原因揭開這些受人喜愛的鳥類的神秘面紗,想想是讓牠們的叫聲繼續成為夏天的配樂還是永遠沉寂下去

programme.title: 馬拉威野生拯救隊 #1
programme.desc: 阿曼達回到救援中心搶救纏在偷獵者鐵絲網中的一頭小象,阿爾瑪嘗試讓初到貴境又可愛至極綽號「手繪波波」的狒狒嬰兒與狒狒養母建立關係

programme.title: 馬拉威野生拯救隊 #2
programme.desc: 阿曼達為在馬拉威二十年來出生的首批獵豹幼崽的其中一隻戴上無線電頸圈;團隊努力給一條4米長的蟒蛇一個身體檢查;一群遊客則送來一隻從寵物販賣中救出來的暴躁猴子嬰兒

programme.title: 馬拉威野生拯救隊 #3
programme.desc: 團隊準備釋放兩隻被稱為藪貓的美麗且難以捕捉的斑點貓,但計劃出了亂子,其中一隻逃到危險的里朗威同時,猴子嬰兒情況危急,全員出動救亡

programme.title: 馬拉威野生拯救隊 #4
programme.desc: 阿曼達進行了恐怖的開墾冒險之旅,以營救被偷獵者捕網抓獲的水羚中心內的鬣狗居民的耳朵被蠅咬而接受治療阿爾瑪接到了一個深夜運送猴子的神秘任務

programme.title: 馬拉威野生拯救隊 #5
programme.desc: 阿曼達和到訪的獸醫蘇菲竭力讓一頭斷腿的長尾猴有機會重返野外阿爾瑪接收了一頭特殊的孤兒 - 像貓般的獛屬,和一頭反社會的狒狒,也有機會加入部落

programme.title: 非洲獵人 #1
programme.desc: 本集跟隨一隻老邁的豹子三天,她正努力覓食,同時試圖避開惡魔般的鄰居:一個清道夫獅子群

programme.title: 非洲獵人 #2
programme.desc: 在尚比亞,一隻年老的豹子即將面臨生命中最嚴峻的挑戰:一隻更年輕,更健康,更強壯的雌豹正逼近她的領土,準備爭奪它這將是一場年齡和經驗對決年輕和活力的大戰

programme.title: 非洲獵人 #4 英普
programme.desc: 一起來認識小雌豹奇帕祖亞的魅力,她受到母親的悉心照顧,因此從未需要自己捕獵這是她生命中第一次獨自生活,她能否絕地求生,培養出所需的狩獵技能?

programme.title: 雪豹獵奇 #1
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​與丹一同踏上旅程,穿越嚴酷無情的蒙古荒野,只為尋找那隻史上有紀錄以來體型最大的雪豹:「老兄」(The Dude)目睹他如何在充滿敵意,危機四伏的地形與環境中奮力前行,並在未知與不確定中披荊斬棘,同時揭示「老兄」以及其他雪豹在生存上所面臨的艱難挑戰與嚴峻現實

programme.title: 雪豹獵奇 #2
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​跟隨丹與他的團隊,一同在「老兄」的領地中嗅探,追蹤,他們懷疑雌性雪豹在雪豹族群中的角色,可能遠比先前想像的更加關鍵,更具影響力當丹意外發現一群雪豹聚集的反常現象時,對雪豹行為的既有研究與認知也因此受到衝擊與挑戰

programme.title: 野獸絕地求生記 #6 英普
programme.desc: 本集帶觀眾與豹同行,跟隨這些自然界的偽裝大師,隱沒於斯里蘭卡的叢林之中深入了解這種強大的貓科獵手,如何完美適應島上炎熱乾燥的氣候,並學習牠們的追蹤和獵食技巧

programme.title: 野生動物明星 #1
programme.desc: 非洲的三大貓科動物:獅子,花豹和獵豹雖然並肩而居,但他們各自發展出專門的狩獵策略,以避免彼此衝突深入了解這些頂級獵食者的生活和故事

programme.title: 非洲野狗:族群對獅群 #6
programme.desc: 和卡昆比族群一起返回巢穴,這個族群正在哀悼兩隻失去的幼崽偶遇一個鬣狗窩和一頭獅子試圖放倒一頭水牛的場面,然後跟上曼齊族群的步伐,目睹牠們與一隻豹子和一群憤怒大象的對峙

programme.title: 歐洲野性王國 #1
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​發現歐洲最佳建築如何為一些大陸上最稀有的物種創造庇護所前往法國,蘇格蘭和西班牙,在那裡,海豹,鳥類,蠑螈,野貓和蛇類在水邊的古老地標之間茁壯成長

programme.title: 歐洲野性王國 #2
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​在歐洲最壯觀的山峰之中見證動物的戲劇造訪羅馬尼亞和法國的中世紀城堡,那裡的熊,猞猁和獵鷹正在復甦,然後看看在比利牛斯山中巧妙適應氣候變化的岩蜥蜴

programme.title: 驕傲之地:野地回春
programme.desc: 一個澳洲家庭在南非的一個古老狩獵牧場進行修復他們的目標是重建過度生長的棲息地,建立生態旅游牧場,並允許包括獵食者在內的自然野生動植物搬回家

programme.title: 超獸 #1
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​沉浸在動物王國中最強大生物的驚人力量之中與銀背大猩猩一起衝破堅硬的白蟻丘,觀察能夠壓碎凱門鱷頭骨的美洲豹,然後前往海洋目睹虎鯨成群獵食的情景

programme.title: 超獸 #2
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​與地球上最快的動物運動員一起加速觀看死亡加德蛇在瞬間出擊,與遊隼一起進行空中暗殺,與變色龍一起捕捉快速的食物,並面對在海雀俯衝獵物時的驚人G力

programme.title: 鯊魚星球 #1
programme.desc: 與鯊魚一起在海中潛行,看他們使用高度敏銳的感官和殺手的本能進行捕獵觀看白頂礁鯊利用其電子傳感器探測心跳來尋找獵物,以及淺海長尾鯊用其鞭狀的尾巴來擊暈獵物

programme.title: 歐洲野性王國 #1

programme.title: 非洲野狗:族群對獅群 #5
programme.desc: 目睹卡昆比族群將一隻跟蹤牠們的豹子趕到樹上,你會感到心跳加速加入朱爾茲的ZCP獅子項圈任務,與偵察員西蒙一起釣魚,探索野狗族群在進食期間的等級關係,並見證一場陪伴一隻受重傷卡昆比幼崽的令人心碎的守夜

programme.title: 生命之旅 #1 英普
programme.desc: 撐過嬰兒期是地球上幾乎所有物種的最大挑戰在非洲荒野,生死的平衡很容易傾側,動物必須成長並迅速學習,才能度過生命的第一階段

programme.title: 野小子 #1 英普
programme.desc: 在納米比亞中部,一群非洲野犬在乾旱的土地上漫遊受到獅子和乾旱兩面夾擊,一隻名為賴卡的勇敢幼崽必須快速成長,學習獵人的技能,並找到自己在族群中的定位

programme.title: 野小子 #2 英普
programme.desc: 在南非的大克魯格國家公園,一頭名為青加的幼崽出生在馬啦馬啦獅群這個獵人世家中在忠實的父親,嚴母和淘氣的姐姐指導下,青加找到她在族群中的定位

programme.title: 野小子 #3 英普
programme.desc: 小獵豹烏珊娜生長在不利環境中很少小獵豹能夠撐過一歲但她很幸運,有一位厲害的母親,她會不惜一切保護幼崽安全烏珊娜只需跟隨她的腳步

programme.title: 野小子 #4 英普
programme.desc: 在巴西卡皮瓦拉山脈國家公園裡,小卷尾猴施高正學習如何融入規則複雜的族群,並探索充滿刺激和危機處處的森林但純熟地掌控工具才是他的生存關鍵

programme.title: 野小子 #5 英普
programme.desc: 在印度,年幼獅尾猴華菲面對著不斷縮小的棲息地和人類世界的侵擾幸運的是,他有一位慈母,一位防範的父親,一位淘氣的姐姐,以及眾多親戚都在看顧他

programme.title: 潛鳥:迷霧中的吶喊
programme.desc: 與生物學家們一起爭分奪秒,試圖找出北美潛鳥突然瀕臨滅絕的原因揭開這些受人喜愛的鳥類的神秘面紗,想想是讓牠們的叫聲繼續成為夏天的配樂還是永遠沉寂下去

programme.title: 馬拉威野生拯救隊 #1
programme.desc: 阿曼達回到救援中心搶救纏在偷獵者鐵絲網中的一頭小象,阿爾瑪嘗試讓初到貴境又可愛至極綽號「手繪波波」的狒狒嬰兒與狒狒養母建立關係

programme.title: 馬拉威野生拯救隊 #2
programme.desc: 阿曼達為在馬拉威二十年來出生的首批獵豹幼崽的其中一隻戴上無線電頸圈;團隊努力給一條4米長的蟒蛇一個身體檢查;一群遊客則送來一隻從寵物販賣中救出來的暴躁猴子嬰兒

programme.title: 馬拉威野生拯救隊 #3
programme.desc: 團隊準備釋放兩隻被稱為藪貓的美麗且難以捕捉的斑點貓,但計劃出了亂子,其中一隻逃到危險的里朗威同時,猴子嬰兒情況危急,全員出動救亡

programme.title: 馬拉威野生拯救隊 #4
programme.desc: 阿曼達進行了恐怖的開墾冒險之旅,以營救被偷獵者捕網抓獲的水羚中心內的鬣狗居民的耳朵被蠅咬而接受治療阿爾瑪接到了一個深夜運送猴子的神秘任務

programme.title: 馬拉威野生拯救隊 #5
programme.desc: 阿曼達和到訪的獸醫蘇菲竭力讓一頭斷腿的長尾猴有機會重返野外阿爾瑪接收了一頭特殊的孤兒 - 像貓般的獛屬,和一頭反社會的狒狒,也有機會加入部落

programme.title: 非洲獵人 #1
programme.desc: 本集跟隨一隻老邁的豹子三天,她正努力覓食,同時試圖避開惡魔般的鄰居:一個清道夫獅子群

programme.title: 非洲獵人 #2
programme.desc: 在尚比亞,一隻年老的豹子即將面臨生命中最嚴峻的挑戰:一隻更年輕,更健康,更強壯的雌豹正逼近她的領土,準備爭奪它這將是一場年齡和經驗對決年輕和活力的大戰

programme.title: 非洲獵人 #4 英普
programme.desc: 一起來認識小雌豹奇帕祖亞的魅力,她受到母親的悉心照顧,因此從未需要自己捕獵這是她生命中第一次獨自生活,她能否絕地求生,培養出所需的狩獵技能?

programme.title: 雪豹獵奇 #1
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​與丹一同踏上旅程,穿越嚴酷無情的蒙古荒野,只為尋找那隻史上有紀錄以來體型最大的雪豹:「老兄」(The Dude)目睹他如何在充滿敵意,危機四伏的地形與環境中奮力前行,並在未知與不確定中披荊斬棘,同時揭示「老兄」以及其他雪豹在生存上所面臨的艱難挑戰與嚴峻現實

programme.title: 雪豹獵奇 #2
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​跟隨丹與他的團隊,一同在「老兄」的領地中嗅探,追蹤,他們懷疑雌性雪豹在雪豹族群中的角色,可能遠比先前想像的更加關鍵,更具影響力當丹意外發現一群雪豹聚集的反常現象時,對雪豹行為的既有研究與認知也因此受到衝擊與挑戰

programme.title: 歐洲野性王國 #1

programme.title: 驕傲之地:野地回春
programme.desc: 一個澳洲家庭在南非的一個古老狩獵牧場進行修復他們的目標是重建過度生長的棲息地,建立生態旅游牧場,並允許包括獵食者在內的自然野生動植物搬回家

programme.title: 超獸 #1
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​沉浸在動物王國中最強大生物的驚人力量之中與銀背大猩猩一起衝破堅硬的白蟻丘,觀察能夠壓碎凱門鱷頭骨的美洲豹,然後前往海洋目睹虎鯨成群獵食的情景

programme.title: 鯊魚星球 #1

programme.title: 大貓九命 #1
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​描繪獅子生命的九個階段,從無助的小獅子到自信的成年獅,再到年老的流亡者看看競爭,飢餓和驕傲的動態如何塑造它在塞倫蓋提的生活,並見證使這種社交貓獨特的忠誠和合作精神

programme.title: 野性菲律賓 #1
programme.desc: 沉浸在由火山,森林與海洋塑造而成,彼此緊密相連的野生生命之中與稀有的菲律賓鷹一同飛翔,看牠們在一棵古老大樹裡養育幼鳥;接著潛入河流,設法一瞥世界上最稀有的鱷魚

programme.title: 野性菲律賓 #2
programme.desc: 潛入清澈見底的海洋,探索圖巴塔哈礁,這片礁體坐落在一座已熄滅的海底火山之上;那裡的淺潟湖庇護著海龜與鼬鯊也與眼鏡猴一同騰躍飛掠,看牠們靠著樹木之間強而有力的跳躍來獵捕昆蟲

programme.title: 鯊魚星球 #2
programme.desc: 與那些在藍色的虛空中繁衍生息的流浪鯊魚一起領略海洋的廣闊,深邃與黑暗見識穿越大西洋風暴的海域的孤獨藍鯊,以及返回太平洋島嶼繁殖地的數百條雙髻鯊

programme.title: 「礁」來船禍 #1
programme.desc: 波奈的裙礁是過千種珊瑚,魚類和其他海洋動物的家園,也是許多令人驚嘆的沉船的墓園這些殘骸隨著時日的推移而進化成人工珊瑚,支撐著令人難以置信的多樣性海洋棲息地

programme.title: 超獸 #1
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​沉浸在動物王國中最強大生物的驚人力量之中與銀背大猩猩一起衝破堅硬的白蟻丘,觀察能夠壓碎凱門鱷頭骨的美洲豹,然後前往海洋目睹虎鯨成群獵食的情景

programme.title: 超獸 #2
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​與地球上最快的動物運動員一起加速觀看死亡加德蛇在瞬間出擊,與遊隼一起進行空中暗殺,與變色龍一起捕捉快速的食物,並面對在海雀俯衝獵物時的驚人G力

programme.title: 雪豹獵奇 #1
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​與丹一同踏上旅程,穿越嚴酷無情的蒙古荒野,只為尋找那隻史上有紀錄以來體型最大的雪豹:「老兄」(The Dude)目睹他如何在充滿敵意,危機四伏的地形與環境中奮力前行,並在未知與不確定中披荊斬棘,同時揭示「老兄」以及其他雪豹在生存上所面臨的艱難挑戰與嚴峻現實

programme.title: 野性菲律賓 #1
programme.desc: 沉浸在由火山,森林與海洋塑造而成,彼此緊密相連的野生生命之中與稀有的菲律賓鷹一同飛翔,看牠們在一棵古老大樹裡養育幼鳥;接著潛入河流,設法一瞥世界上最稀有的鱷魚

programme.title: 野性菲律賓 #2
programme.desc: 潛入清澈見底的海洋,探索圖巴塔哈礁,這片礁體坐落在一座已熄滅的海底火山之上;那裡的淺潟湖庇護著海龜與鼬鯊也與眼鏡猴一同騰躍飛掠,看牠們靠著樹木之間強而有力的跳躍來獵捕昆蟲

programme.desc: Guppies in the wild aren't as beautiful as we see them in the aquarium Many think they are mosquitofishes, but in reality, wild guppies and mosquitofishes were originally introduced from abroad for the purpose of preventing and treating malaria However, unlike mosquitofishes, they are not seen everywhere in the wild Instead, they were introduced into the aquarium market Because guppies have genetic variability, especially the changing colors and patterns on their tail fins, their original wild patterns and colors have gradually been forgotten by everyone

programme.title: Cute Pet At Home
programme.desc: The Call duck is a domestic duck species native to the Netherlands Males can weigh about 570 to 680 grams Because its call is different from other ducks, Call Ducks were bred as hunting ducks, now most of them are used as pets They mainly live in the Netherlands, Japan, and Southeast Asia They were introduced to the pet market in recent years and were originally used by European hunters to lure wild ducks using their call Their ducklings are described as having fair skin, big breasts and round butts They can heal people's moods, and their cute appearance adds joy

programme.title: Banzai Switzerland
programme.desc: Someone in Japan is in love with Switzerland, its culture, its folklore and, more specifically: the Swiss alphorn! The Tamagawa Alphorn Club from Nanasawa, Japan, is travelling to Switzerland to attend the International Alphorn Festival in Nendaz at the end of July Alphorn playing started to be known in Japan in the 80ies and is becoming more and more popular in the last decade among retired people, but not only Shigetoshi Nakagawa, founder of the group and a forest expert, is one of the first people who started to play the instrument; he has instructed to build and play the Alphorn in numerous regions, among children and elderly people Thousands of Alphorn Clubs have been born lately and more and more Japanese are being interested in Swiss folklore culture and Switzerland in general

programme.title: The Natural History of the Chicken
programme.desc: A quirky documentary exploring chickens beyond food, through eccentric stories of headless runners, supernatural tales, and a woman who'd rather bond than eat them

programme.title: K2 and The Invisible Footmen
programme.desc: K2 is widely seen as the world's harshest mountain Yet many indigenous porters make a living in its extreme conditions, carrying provisions for foreign climbing expeditions Often risking their lives with only rudimentary equipment, they receive minimal pay for their efforts Against a backdrop of breathtaking natural beauty, this cinematic doc explores the everyday courage and sacrifice of the men who call the 'Savage Mountain' their home

programme.desc: It is the most serious scandal ever hitting the modern art market An affair that has made experts and auction houses tremble and has re-proposed the ghost of forgery The facts date back to 2017 in Genoa, where an exhibition dedicated to the painter Amedeo Modigliani from Livorno was closed by the Public Prosecutor’s Office, which put 21 paintings out of the 60 on display under seizure

programme.title: A Russian Fairytale
programme.desc: Following the break up of the Soviet union, a gang of children from broken homes made a new life together inside the derelict buildings of a once secret weapons manufacturing city In their childhood innocence, they thought they were living a fairytale dream of freedom, but with starvation and sub zero temperatures crippling their health, reality soon hit home Despite their efforts to care for one another, three members of their group died For the survivors: they must try against hopeless odds to turn their lives around

programme.title: Black and Blue
programme.desc: In 2011, six police officers in Fullerton, California, beat Kelly Thomas, a homeless schizophrenic man, so badly that he died of his injuries Three years later, protests in Hollywood sparked after the officers were acquitted or had their charges dropped Renowned filmmaker Dylan Avery attended the protest and, before he knew it, he was swept up into a world of grieving family members, retired police officers that now criticize the very system they used to serve, and civilians who have suffered brutality at the hands of those sworn to protect Over the next two years, Avery followed multiple cases and developments that coincided with historic protests on the streets of Ferguson and Baltimore against institutionalized police racism and brutality

programme.title: 屬靈教室: 啟示錄研讀-張永信牧師
programme.desc: 聖經最後的一卷啟示錄,常被信徒,甚至普世人類所注重。可惜的是,被誤解和誤用的情況卻很普遍。解釋啟示錄最大的問題,便是讀者們對於此書卷的體裁所知甚少,以致不明白詮釋啟示錄的方法。本節目傾重於對啟示錄體裁的闡釋,讓觀眾明白如何將方法論,應用在各有關的經文上。

programme.title: 屬靈教室:蔡錦圖博士-保羅腳蹤
programme.desc: 使徒保羅足跡遍及大馬士革、耶路撒冷、安提亞、路區得、庇哩亞、雅典、羅馬等,沙田浸信會傳道蔡錦圖博士,就會按地方有系統地講解保羅的生平,從中激勵我們學習初期使徒,為主擺上,跟隨耶穌的腳蹤行。

programme.title: 喜樂婆婆會客室

programme.title: 香港遊樂團粵
programme.desc: 滕麗名、吳家樂、江欣燕、胡諾言、梁嘉琪、陳浚霆到訪石鼓洲康復院，男院友平日負責修葺設施，而由院友一手一腳建成的羅馬式儲水池，令眾主持嘆為觀止。六人難得來到，當然不只是遊覽。他們分成兩隊做義工，一組展開「髹牆」旅程，另一組則修剪草坪，埋頭苦幹了一個早上。辛苦事陸續有來，眾人最後還要修建道路，要知道擔泥舖地絕非小兒科粗活，他們雖然做到汗流浹背，但大功告成的一刻卻有種難以形容的滿足。

programme.title: 香港遊樂團粵
programme.desc: 吳家樂、滕麗名、胡諾言、江欣燕、梁嘉琪、陳浚霆繼續在石鼓洲康復院服務，先嘗試廢物利用「揼鞋架」，事後竟強迫木工導師稱讚每份傑作！眾人又自告奮勇清潔獨立「羊」房、露天龜池，一邊做一邊胡鬧，在勞碌的探訪中尋找樂趣。石鼓洲風光宜人，欣欣與阿滕趁美景當前，展露巧手廚藝鼓勵院友；禮尚往來，院方義工亦炮製了「石鼓洲炒飯」分甘同味。回到市區，家樂邀請張智軒、喬寶寶與立志遠離毒品的年青人比賽足球，戰況如何？

programme.title: Do姐有問題粵
programme.desc: 多位「好戲之人」同來接受Do姐考驗，田蕊妮與李思捷組隊，迎戰黎耀祥和胡定欣。泰國夜市海鮮檔為食客提供「三寶」，當中的冰桶有甚麼作用？阿田答對題目，為何卻咀咒自己會扣分？台北貓舍收容了不少貓貓，負責人想出「屎橋」，能讓貓咪們「自給自足」！東京老字號專賣店主打一種竹製品，到底是甚麼？雨傘專門店有售超過一萬把雨傘，其中一款設計獨特的「縮骨遮」更可用作保護某物件。今集兌換獎金創出新高，哪一隊是幸運兒？

programme.title: 十築台灣粵普
programme.desc: 隨韻潔到台中一間由舊樓改建的旅宿，牆身的鋼筋、水泥突顯出原始、粗獷感，而天井配合燈光有何效果？露台除可增加採光度，當中的植物亦為舊建築帶來生命力。台11線兼具山海靚景，當地一間被藤蔓覆蓋的旅宿，原始簡樸；另一間以灰、黑為主調的旅宿，荒廢感在蔚藍海岸及翠綠植物旁尤為突出，不妨在此享受寧靜、悠閒。一間為單人打造的旅宿，為甚麼會以三角形打造空間？房間陳設都是向外擺放，讓客人享受獨處時光，同時享受大自然。

programme.title: 十築台灣粵普
programme.desc: 台灣近年越趨重視宗教建築設計，除了知名建築師姚仁喜設計的農禪寺，由德國得獎設計師打造的菁寮聖十字架天主堂亦富有特色。四個鋁建的金字塔形屋頂各有雕像，而教堂內有何融入台灣文化的設計？台灣護聖宮以玻璃圍繞，可謂突破傳統廟宇的形像，亦結合科技，令建築能抵抗強風與地震。位於宜蘭的長老教會，建築師特意將主堂撐起，亦讓天然光線透進內部建築，主堂的木質蛋形結構有何意思？建築師又講解教堂設計與聖經故事的連繫。

programme.title: 星夢頻道粵日
programme.desc: 吉祥物Bug Bug CHU身體不適，讓老氣妹壞壞相當擔心，更找上小光商量。就在這時，神秘人物在她們面前出現，並說只有做演唱會才能治好Bug Bug CHU，但老氣妹壞壞並不擅長唱歌跳舞，情急之下又向小光求助……

programme.title: 喜羊羊與灰太狼之羊羊趣冒險2粵普
喜羊羊與灰太狼之羊羊趣冒險2粵普
多啦A夢粵
programme.desc: 一群小孩聚集在空地，大家都找到趣味相投的人一起玩以及交流，但唯獨喜歡花繩的大雄孤獨一人。胖虎聽完叔叔的一番說話之後，決定不再欺負人，並且對弱者加以保護。大雄被選中為受保護的對象。

programme.title: 古典樂之星粵日
programme.desc: 貝多芬考試不及格，再此下去會有退學之虞。蕭邦願意為貝多芬補習，但交換條件是貝多芬成為蕭邦隨從，貝多芬惟有陪他採訪、購物，被他連番折騰。但接下來蕭邦在舞台上的表現，卻震撼了不忘重返拳擊的貝多芬。

programme.title: 盲盒鐵路遊粵
programme.desc: 衍峰、秀怡、嘉慧在重慶未玩夠，繼續遊走。先「貼地」搭民生鐵路，路軌卻離地甚高，絕對「不貼地」，鐵路還會「穿越」大廈，而要影到「吞鐵」打卡相原來不易！食方面亦繼續貼地，坐上矮櫈，將辣麵放在高櫈上進食，品嚐其「麻辣鮮香」的特色！再試由幾種家鄉風味隨意混搭出的草根美味，一嚐江湖菜滋味。突發盲盒任務，三人被蒙眼帶往某景點，打開眼罩已置身高空玻璃平台，節目組還安排升級任務，要主持們在懸空步道走一圈！

programme.title: 香港美食匠人粵
programme.desc: 經歷高低起跌，名廚黃永幟對烹飪仍保持一份堅持與執着。幟哥親力親為到海鮮市場揀貨，芷珊前往取經，再一嚐惹火龍蝦菜。XO醬如何由名貴小食變特色調味料？這位「XO醬兼楊枝甘露之父」談及味道平衡的重要。人生下半場決心轉行，匠人蘇炎文將裁縫精神注入流心燉蛋，更闖出名堂。除了揀蛋、奶有要求，燉煮時間都超精準！蝦子麵要將麵粉與高湯完美調和，麵廠主理人陳漢傑承繼父業後體會到父親之苦。老字號引入改革，面對甚麼挑戰？

programme.title: 香港美食匠人粵
programme.desc: 本地掀起多時的新派酥皮蛋撻熱潮，與一位在港落地生根的瑞士烘焙大師息息相關。大師焗製的酸種蛋撻據悉每日吸引長龍，為免顧客撲空失望，他更不辭勞苦加班製作。他亦熱愛香港美食，還嘗試將叉燒等融入包餅中。清晨開爐熬製的香綿粥底，加上以銅煲滾煮，一碗美味的鮮魚粥才告誕生。據指有外地人念念不忘專程再來吃粥，支持主理人的烹調用心。潮州菜館師傅醉心鑽研滷水，勇敢跳出傳統框架，採用嶄新材料搭配，芷珊大讚出品層次豐富。

programme.title: 初入職場·中醫季粵普
programme.desc: 《初入職場·中醫季》深度聚焦中醫文化，攜手中醫專業人才及中醫助力團一起，通過"潮養生活"與"中醫歷練"，開啟一場年輕態的中醫文化科普之旅。

programme.title: 澳洲潮什麼粵
programme.desc: 來到陽光海岸，動靜皆宜，漫步六十公里長灘好Chill；乘坐前水警艇在海上高速起伏、轉彎，則刺激十足！到農場擠駱駝奶先要取得其信任？駱駝也「黏人」，還主動向芷珮「送抱」。再結識另一動物朋友，騎馬踏步海灘，迎接閃閃浪花。遊船河感受原住民風情，兼享美酒佳餚，深入了解當地文化。行逛人氣市集後，芷珮勇闖叢林挑戰高空飛索、繩網障礙，考驗身手與膽量。大沼澤地生態也值得遊人探索，坐船穿梭河道濕地，見識大自然奧妙。

programme.title: 甜心先生粵
programme.desc: 港姐季軍郭嘉文勤奮好學，自當選以來工作機會不斷。她在節目中接受另一挑戰，與阿古(古嘉俊)合力製作一款「茉莉熱情果薑味牛奶朱古力馬卡龍」，融合二人創意炮製出精彩滋味。期間阿古竟要她將牛油紙視為「仇人」？

programme.title: 星光魔法粵日
programme.desc: 希娜要為雜誌拍照，祭跟著去學習，同場的還有米露琪。另一名模特兒因病缺席，攝影師相中祭，讓她臨時頂替，米露琪不是味兒，故意教祭錯誤知識。最後工作人員提議拍攝星光魔法，米露琪竟然推卻。

programme.title: Hands Up粵
programme.desc: 十一歲男生受表哥薰陶而對法國號產生興趣。他將這款音色獨特的管樂器帶上「My Little Show」舞台，即場吹奏一曲。十位小朋友同聲合唱< Somewhere over the rainbow，主持姐姐大讚聲音柔和，令人容易投入歌曲中的故事。圍繞「校園成長」主題，主持們與結他導師合唱<分飛燕、<十八相送。大家還分享讀書時的青春熱血回憶，Emily和Tiffany姐姐均自言是安靜的乖寶寶。

programme.title: 屁屁偵探粵日
programme.desc: 改編自人氣繪本。各位小朋友快跟著無人不知的名偵探屁屁偵探全面出擊，透過細心觀察及推理，偵破各類案件吧！

programme.title: 櫻桃小丸子粵日
programme.desc: 小丸子被推舉成為組長，負責統籌話劇排練，起初因受稱讚而得意，後因貪玩取消練習惹眾人不滿，終承認錯誤。小丸子陪爺爺搭巴士去做針灸，覺得按下車鈴充滿樂趣，後來卻發現有一男孩搶著按鈴。

programme.title: 好嘢港多啲粵
programme.desc: 香港特區政府帶領各個部門及單位，適時推出不同的政策措施，為本港市民、到訪旅客、來自外地的投資者提供便捷服務。香港這麼好，當然要多說一些讓大家知道。《好嘢港多啲》以輕鬆有趣的拍攝手法，配合陳豪、高海寧、張振朗、劉佩玥、周嘉洛、羅子溢、馬國明、陳懿德、陳展鵬、劉穎鏇等一眾星級藝員，透過不同角色、形象，生動地表達香港的各樣美好和優勢。

programme.title: 財經透視粵
programme.desc: 社會對疾病預防及健康管理的觀念越來越重視，除了醫院及醫療集團，紛紛投放資源開展相關服務。近年連一些非醫療機構都轉型開拓復康、護理等新業務，這個現象會為本地醫療產業發展帶來怎樣的變化？

programme.title: 六點半新聞報道粵
programme.desc: 翡翠台每日下午六點半，報道本地、兩岸及國際重要新聞。

programme.title: 農本方參苓白朮散呈獻:天氣報告粵
邵逸夫獎2026粵
programme.desc: 2026年度邵逸夫天文學獎平均頒予野本憲一，以及斯坦福‧伍斯利，以表彰他們對恆星爆炸和元素起源的研究。而數學科學獎則由伊曼紐爾‧康德斯和卡米洛‧德‧雷列斯獲得，以表彰他們在運用深刻數學分析技術，解決重要應用方面取得的突破性貢獻。

programme.title: 警聲百二秒 IV粵
programme.desc: 《警聲百二秒 IV》引領觀眾「上天下海」、甚至「穿梭過去未來」，並繼續以輕鬆有趣的系列表達方式，讓市民接收豐富的警隊資訊，說好香港警察故事。

programme.title: 東張西望粵
programme.desc: 有中學生家長發現兒子被迫加入某通訊群組，而群組管理員疑似有背景，並向群組成員索取金錢。前DJ路芙轉戰殯儀界，認識一名業界女負責人，未上班便被邀吃飯見面？二人第二度合作後，女負責人要求路芙簽一份死約才發放佣金，然而合約要求離職後一年內不得從事殯儀業！《美食強人》導嚐團再出發，伍允龍再夥拍團員去試獲得「GBA評級」的食肆，這次的美食有帶來驚喜嗎？有銀行於銅鑼灣開設旗艦分行，為客人提供更多貼心服務。

programme.title: 中信銀行(國際)Motion$呈獻：試真D唷粵
programme.desc: 本集延續台北試食行程。主持們於午市光顧高評分素食餐廳，看到座無虛席的場面，原本寄予厚望。無奈嚐過絲瓜小籠包、酸菜魚等菜式後，某主持直言該店名大於實！珍珠奶茶配鍋燒意麵的破格組合，令朱仔入店前亦想「縮沙」。儘管湯頭的奶茶味道「失蹤」，大家卻都讚意麵相當滋味。喝湯可反映身體健康狀況，而每位要索價逾六百港元？湯還未入口，美儀姐單憑氣味已臉色一變；朱仔自言愛喝湯，美儀姐即提醒他不要盲目「立Flag」……

programme.title: Funki Finance 呈獻：女神配對計劃2粵
programme.desc: 女神水上常識問答比賽，眾男考驗對同組女神的了解度，還要激鬥浮台搶位戰！遊戲揭露女神小秘密，識得開槍、鍾意聞男友汗味都未算誇，某女神竟試過被十多位男士同時追求？不分組別專屬題戰火升級，情敵們為博表現正面交鋒，有人參戰只求搞事？本輪最高分的女神可揀對象共度浪漫約會，人選估你唔到！好感度投票時間，花生團會淘汰兩名求愛勇者，女神如零票也難逃出局命運。殘酷過後有福利，收穫吊墜的男士將可與女神單獨過夜……

programme.title: 及時雨信貸呈獻：一周星星粵
programme.desc: 主持王鎮泉邀來「模範夫妻」吳岱融和鍾淑慧要取經，但泉叔跟岱融哥竟於《巨輪II》有合作？還是關注兩夫妻的緣分之始較恰當，一同重溫定情作《人．鬼．狐》。岱融哥當年被稱為「新加坡第一帥哥」，吸引淑慧的卻是其柔軟度似蜘蛛？岱融哥對老婆的初印象又是如何？岱融哥不時為妻子製造驚喜，令淑慧最深刻一次，發生甚麼事？岱融哥提到愛錫一個人，需常常將愛意告知對方；泉叔要求他在鏡頭前向淑慧講「我愛你」，岱融哥亦隨即行動！

programme.title: 伯樂音樂學院20週年呈獻：J Music粵
programme.desc: 黃妍對可跟原唱人劉浩龍「一晚限定」合唱<滄海遺珠大感高興，她同時亦帶來新歌<福來的日子。林奕匡受九十年代電影啟發靈感，創作出<初戀無限Touch。Michael C則藉<傷口不算甚麼，與不太好的緣分講再見；他還形容填詞人梁嘉茵是「聖母」，何出此言？此外，許文軒倒數本星期「勁歌金榜」二十首上榜歌曲，並相約MYNT魔音女團暢談參與節目後成團的各項挑戰。

programme.title: 美食新聞周報粵
programme.desc: 蕭欣浩博士帶行仔造訪元朗懷舊糖水舖，細味遠年陳皮紅豆沙、石磨芝麻糊湯圓等手工古法糖水，並細說相關典故。荔枝角的西班牙餐廳主打當地特色美食，以本地小銀魚、鮮魷炮製的脆炸小食及招牌海鮮飯，均不容錯過。大廚陳國強帶暉哥到台灣過江龍餐廳，享用「人氣」鐵觀音珍珠奶茶及半筋半肉紅燒牛肉麵，風味正宗。黃嘉雯駕車載胡美貽到荃灣的酒店，品嚐特色下午茶，包括鴨肝西多士及由區內老字號食店供應的馳名糯米糍，滋味十足。

programme.title: 晚間新聞粵
programme.desc: 報道本地、兩岸、國際重要新聞以及體育消息，讓你洞悉各地大事及體壇動向。

programme.desc: 高子樂發現杜以盈乘坐的車上有血跡，覺得可疑，卻在許森的舉報下，拿不到行車記錄儀的紀錄；嘉軒回憶起與許森一起長大的故事，許的神祕面紗慢慢揭開；Mike發現有人跟蹤他，跟蹤者還很快被滅口，一切矛頭指向Mike。

programme.title: 東張西望粵
programme.desc: 有中學生家長發現兒子被迫加入某通訊群組，而群組管理員疑似有背景，並向群組成員索取金錢。前DJ路芙轉戰殯儀界，認識一名業界女負責人，未上班便被邀吃飯見面？二人第二度合作後，女負責人要求路芙簽一份死約才發放佣金，然而合約要求離職後一年內不得從事殯儀業！《美食強人》導嚐團再出發，伍允龍再夥拍團員去試獲得「GBA評級」的食肆，這次的美食有帶來驚喜嗎？有銀行於銅鑼灣開設旗艦分行，為客人提供更多貼心服務。

programme.title: 初入職場·中醫季粵普
programme.desc: 《初入職場·中醫季》深度聚焦中醫文化，攜手中醫專業人才及中醫助力團一起，通過"潮養生活"與"中醫歷練"，開啟一場年輕態的中醫文化科普之旅。

programme.title: 澳洲潮什麼粵
programme.desc: 來到陽光海岸，動靜皆宜，漫步六十公里長灘好Chill；乘坐前水警艇在海上高速起伏、轉彎，則刺激十足！到農場擠駱駝奶先要取得其信任？駱駝也「黏人」，還主動向芷珮「送抱」。再結識另一動物朋友，騎馬踏步海灘，迎接閃閃浪花。遊船河感受原住民風情，兼享美酒佳餚，深入了解當地文化。行逛人氣市集後，芷珮勇闖叢林挑戰高空飛索、繩網障礙，考驗身手與膽量。大沼澤地生態也值得遊人探索，坐船穿梭河道濕地，見識大自然奧妙。

programme.title: 甜心先生粵
programme.desc: 港姐季軍郭嘉文勤奮好學，自當選以來工作機會不斷。她在節目中接受另一挑戰，與阿古(古嘉俊)合力製作一款「茉莉熱情果薑味牛奶朱古力馬卡龍」，融合二人創意炮製出精彩滋味。期間阿古竟要她將牛油紙視為「仇人」？

programme.title: 盲盒鐵路遊粵
programme.desc: 衍峰、秀怡、嘉慧在重慶未玩夠，繼續遊走。先「貼地」搭民生鐵路，路軌卻離地甚高，絕對「不貼地」，鐵路還會「穿越」大廈，而要影到「吞鐵」打卡相原來不易！食方面亦繼續貼地，坐上矮櫈，將辣麵放在高櫈上進食，品嚐其「麻辣鮮香」的特色！再試由幾種家鄉風味隨意混搭出的草根美味，一嚐江湖菜滋味。突發盲盒任務，三人被蒙眼帶往某景點，打開眼罩已置身高空玻璃平台，節目組還安排升級任務，要主持們在懸空步道走一圈！

programme.title: 香港美食匠人粵
programme.desc: 經歷高低起跌，名廚黃永幟對烹飪仍保持一份堅持與執着。幟哥親力親為到海鮮市場揀貨，芷珊前往取經，再一嚐惹火龍蝦菜。XO醬如何由名貴小食變特色調味料？這位「XO醬兼楊枝甘露之父」談及味道平衡的重要。人生下半場決心轉行，匠人蘇炎文將裁縫精神注入流心燉蛋，更闖出名堂。除了揀蛋、奶有要求，燉煮時間都超精準！蝦子麵要將麵粉與高湯完美調和，麵廠主理人陳漢傑承繼父業後體會到父親之苦。老字號引入改革，面對甚麼挑戰？

programme.title: 香港美食匠人粵
programme.desc: 本地掀起多時的新派酥皮蛋撻熱潮，與一位在港落地生根的瑞士烘焙大師息息相關。大師焗製的酸種蛋撻據悉每日吸引長龍，為免顧客撲空失望，他更不辭勞苦加班製作。他亦熱愛香港美食，還嘗試將叉燒等融入包餅中。清晨開爐熬製的香綿粥底，加上以銅煲滾煮，一碗美味的鮮魚粥才告誕生。據指有外地人念念不忘專程再來吃粥，支持主理人的烹調用心。潮州菜館師傅醉心鑽研滷水，勇敢跳出傳統框架，採用嶄新材料搭配，芷珊大讚出品層次豐富。

programme.title: 十築台灣粵普
programme.desc: 隨韻潔到台中一間由舊樓改建的旅宿，牆身的鋼筋、水泥突顯出原始、粗獷感，而天井配合燈光有何效果？露台除可增加採光度，當中的植物亦為舊建築帶來生命力。台11線兼具山海靚景，當地一間被藤蔓覆蓋的旅宿，原始簡樸；另一間以灰、黑為主調的旅宿，荒廢感在蔚藍海岸及翠綠植物旁尤為突出，不妨在此享受寧靜、悠閒。一間為單人打造的旅宿，為甚麼會以三角形打造空間？房間陳設都是向外擺放，讓客人享受獨處時光，同時享受大自然。

programme.title: 十築台灣粵普
programme.desc: 台灣近年越趨重視宗教建築設計，除了知名建築師姚仁喜設計的農禪寺，由德國得獎設計師打造的菁寮聖十字架天主堂亦富有特色。四個鋁建的金字塔形屋頂各有雕像，而教堂內有何融入台灣文化的設計？台灣護聖宮以玻璃圍繞，可謂突破傳統廟宇的形像，亦結合科技，令建築能抵抗強風與地震。位於宜蘭的長老教會，建築師特意將主堂撐起，亦讓天然光線透進內部建築，主堂的木質蛋形結構有何意思？建築師又講解教堂設計與聖經故事的連繫。

programme.desc: 亨為宣傳特意斥資拍攝一系列瑜珈光碟，更擔任示範導師。可是，亨卻對瑜珈動作一知半解，悅忍不住開聲指點，令亨大怒，指責悅令他顏面盡失。二人回到高家又再吵了起來，令二人的另一半的麗和朋分別成磨心，苦不堪言。

programme.title: 玉樓春#36粵普
programme.desc: 李家人逼孫有德為丈夫殉情，林少春心生一計，暫時幫二姐姐度過難關；孫有德花錢為李想捐生員，他在縣學中聽到旁人對李櫻的議論，羞愧難當；李想背不出書，被考官抓起來，少春趁機慫恿李家分家來救李想。

programme.title: 方德證券獨家呈現:交易現場粵 及 潮流生活誌之玩轉澳門新搞作粵
阿媽教落食平D粵
programme.desc: 陸浩明想轉工任高薪陪月員，就要先學做坐月菜式。肥媽分享個人經驗，為何坐月不能吃牛肉、蝦、蟹或飲汽水？花膠該如何浸發？肥媽示範湯水「鷓鴣燉花膠」及甜品「低糖花膠燉鮮奶」做法，並提醒產婦不應吃太鹹或太甜，否則後果嚴重！滋補菜不一定充滿難度，「黑麻油雞」、「黨參紅棗杞子蒸桂魚」、「花生黑豆木耳肉片煮蛋」全部步驟簡單，隨時連不常下廚的男士，亦能以簡單滋補菜討好另一半！

programme.title: 流行都市粵
programme.desc: 馬尾神經是脊髓神經的延續，如受壓會引致腳軟，甚或影響大小便能力，骨科醫生細說馬尾神經的三個主要功能。延誤治療後果嚴重，醫生提到可透過椎間盤切除手術治理，但長遠要注意日常護脊，為腰椎減壓。青年演員梁振文與梁芷萁因粵劇結下姻緣，最近還自組劇團，芷萁更為了粵劇而放棄專業律師工作？二人預告創團演出會演繹三套經典劇目，並鼓勵年輕朋友多欣賞粵劇，將藝術瑰寶傳承下去。「睇餸食飯」，陳國賓示範「金黃軟心牛肉卷」。

programme.title: LAW霸女神粵

programme.title: 保誠保險呈獻：玫瑰戰爭#1粵PG 及 才駿HASHTAG 科技新指標粵
programme.desc: 夏無雙和關子盈識於微時，並一同加入娛樂圈，子盈更勇奪影后，後來卻傳來子盈投海消息……七年過去，無雙從子盈的日記中，驚悉其悲慘經歷。無雙以法國片廠亞太區代表身分，與天誠娛樂公司老闆陳雲生洽談重拍經典電影《玫瑰》。無雙又與子盈當年好友黎綺雲、藍鳳儀、梁菲雅、林安安重遇，還答應擔任四人所主持綜藝節目的嘉賓，她卻心知當年子盈遭逼上絕路，正與四人有關。節目錄影期間，似是有人存心要令四人自揭瘡疤、作賊心虛……

programme.title: LAW霸女神粵
programme.desc: 經婚姻中介找對象，卻墮入照騙陷阱，能否控告公司違反「商品說明條例」？大家或曾聽聞有人怕被分身家，要求簽婚前協議，但在香港可有法律約束力？祖儀、韵芝接連持相反意見，引發「熱議」。妻子撞破丈夫玩Cyber Sex，能以通姦為由申請離婚嗎？嘉賓方力申本認定等同出軌，但當森美搬出成人影片作例子，即想轉軚……討論到偷偷安裝追蹤App可涉犯法，森美笑稱是關乎全港男士「安危」！律師解說個案，還帶來應對絕招……

programme.title: Hands Up粵
programme.desc: 這集有新到來的曲奇與薯片小兵，接受零食廠廠長蚌蚌公主的考驗。眾人在「廠長話」熱身賽中顯得有些手忙腳亂，但當踏入淘汰賽，其中一隊即時調整狀態，成功全員過關，並贏得零食秘笈。要透過神奇地壺「收集」指定食材，雖然兩隊都未能完成任務，大家的努力仍獲廠長嘉許。攻略「溶化之橋」，曲奇小兵團團長提醒拿着六個雪糕球的隊員不要心急前進，怎料話音未落就已失誤？某薯片小兵挑戰相同數目的雪糕球，運送其間不停自我鼓勵……

programme.title: 麵包超人粵日
programme.desc: 紅精靈要求細菌人把呠呠妹妹帶回來一起玩。但當找到呠呠妹妹時，細菌人發現很怕的秋葵妹妹也在一起。飯團人因為細菌人的襲擊，而意外跌到山下的並暈倒。幸而得到被池沼仔發現了，並保護他免被雨淋。

programme.title: 財經新聞粵
programme.desc: 緊貼市況，逢交易日下午5時50分報道當日本港和外圍股市行情，以及重點財經新聞。

programme.title: 馬百良六寶靈芝呈獻:最強生命線粵 及 潮流生活誌之時尚頭條粵
programme.desc: 睡食症是一種發生在睡眠期間的異常行為，病人會在半夢半醒、無意識的狀態下進食，甚至吃下生肉等食物，醒來後往往對過程毫無記憶。此症常見由傳統安眠藥引起，因此對於長期或大量服用安眠藥的病人、長者及曾有病史的人士而言，有睡食症的機率會相對較高。患者亦會因常在夜間無意識進食、煮食而引致危險及導致體重上升。

programme.title: 六點半新聞報道粵
programme.desc: 翡翠台每日下午六點半，報道本地、兩岸及國際重要新聞。

programme.title: 農本方參苓白朮散呈獻:天氣報告粵
宏利保險呈獻：灣區零距離粵
富途證券特約:富途講美股粵 及 東張西望粵
黃道益活絡油呈獻：愛．回家之三代同糖#66粵
programme.desc: 冠一邀約圓圓下周到馬場，與其父高修及繼母Kamilla見面。加上冠一前女友Erica常找人在網上抨擊她，圓圓下決心積極修身，以最佳姿態示人；搬至「開心小棧」暫住的多勳主動協助她。另一方面，朱基身負特殊任務，龔喜卻希望他能做自己想做的事，她得知朱基來港後一直惦記着某件事，遂鼓勵他放手去做。圓圓在美容中心遇到Erica，遭她搶去心儀的美容師，幸獲朱基施計支開對方。圓圓發現有人跟蹤自己，該人正是朱基……

programme.title: 保誠保險呈獻：玫瑰戰爭#2粵PG
programme.desc: 節目錄影期間意外頻生，眾女直指是無雙從中作梗，無雙否認並當眾力證清白，更因此受傷；子盈舊愛李德龍也注意到事件。眾女探訪無雙時，透露都收到子盈署名的神秘信封。綺雲憶起七年前舊事，子盈獲雲生重用，她則屈居子盈之下。綺雲於拍攝時誤傷子盈，令子盈被換角，其實綺雲早察覺道具槍有異樣；事後，綺雲向雲生自薦，從此開啟成為天誠一姐之路。無雙與雲生在綺雲拍攝現場商討合作事宜，鳳儀自覺像陪襯。綺雲拍攝時，竟發生意外！

programme.title: 與廚同行 家樂牌專業餐飲呈獻：美食強人粵
programme.desc: 內地食店容易購入新鮮乳鴿，而香港餐廳受限於冰鮮貨，這先天差異可會左右這趟乳鴿菜餚評級的結果？廣州珠江新城的星級名店，捨棄主流的紅燒做法，改以鹽焗烹調乳鴿。不過，四隻鴿腿索價破百元，有名廚公開乳鴿來貨價，反映CP值甚低；另一名廚甚至以港式快餐店炸雞作比喻。香港代表則大玩中西融合，廚師將法式嫩煎鴿胸搭配炸釀鴿髀，帶來一鴿二食。現場評審大多給予高分肯定，但嘉賓森美敏銳點出，某細項的評分偏低，有何見解？

programme.title: 武則天#22粵普
programme.desc: 徐慧與李泰結盟，承乾則被迫在皇位與稱心之間選擇。世民與魏徵步步施壓，承乾最終揮劍，似乎親手處決摯愛。

programme.title: 娛樂頭條粵 及 環球新聞檔案粵
programme.desc: 節目主要以當日的娛樂新聞作重點，讓你瞬間掌握影視娛樂圈動態和最新消息，並以「娛樂大事件」、「搶閘頭條」、「出爐猛料」等為主題作頭條新聞式報道。

programme.title: 晚間新聞粵
programme.desc: 報道本地、兩岸、國際重要新聞以及體育消息，讓你洞悉各地大事及體壇動向。

programme.title: 農本方參苓白朮散呈獻:天氣報告粵 及 潮流生活誌之時尚頭條粵
騙中傳奇#7粵PG
programme.desc: 顧井昏迷後，殘生感內疚，遂變賣觀音手，替顧井床上換上絲綢，又買人蔘給顧井補身，忠正懷疑顧井被殘生所害，於是拿走殘生家中之玉器粉末給玉麟鑑定，後更假扮買家引殘生入甕，惜被殘生走脫。忠正再設計令殘生不打自招，承認一直利用忠正及顧井作報復棋子。殘生欲殺忠正滅口，混亂間推跌油燈，火勢蔓延，忠正吃力地將昏迷的顧井拖出屋外，殘生一聲慘叫，令顧井甦醒，即衝入火場，卻欲救無從，殘生被活活燒死。

programme.title: 東張西望粵
programme.desc: 《東張西望》星期一至日，緊貼追蹤社會大事、趣聞逸事，並報道娛樂圈最新動態、藝人消息，以及劇集宣傳和花絮。「今日突發」環節為大家追蹤即日熱門新聞；專題環節，深入探討大眾關心的時事、社會及民生問題，並訪問相關的專家。

programme.title: 流行都市粵
programme.desc: 身體功能會隨歲月慢慢下降，但若多重器官儲備功能全面下跌，導致未能應付日常生活，就可能是「衰弱症」，老人科醫生提醒要留意老友記可有出現五大警號！而飲食清淡、過度照顧竟是加速衰弱的元兇？邵德龍師傅帶隊往佐敦隱世「車胎人推介」潮州菜館，老闆是潮州普寧人，當然可吃到「潮州原味道」！老闆做腸粉起家，先來碟鮮蠔腸粉，眾人再吃傳統小食炒粿肉及蠔餅，還有甚麼「潮」味主食？「睇餸食飯」，三姐示範「老菜甫醋薑炒飯」。

programme.title: LAW霸女神粵
programme.desc: 經婚姻中介找對象，卻墮入照騙陷阱，能否控告公司違反「商品說明條例」？大家或曾聽聞有人怕被分身家，要求簽婚前協議，但在香港可有法律約束力？祖儀、韵芝接連持相反意見，引發「熱議」。妻子撞破丈夫玩Cyber Sex，能以通姦為由申請離婚嗎？嘉賓方力申本認定等同出軌，但當森美搬出成人影片作例子，即想轉軚……討論到偷偷安裝追蹤App可涉犯法，森美笑稱是關乎全港男士「安危」！律師解說個案，還帶來應對絕招……

programme.title: 老表，你好hea！#29粵PG
programme.desc: 軟飯王訓練班導師邀利亞致畢業詞，利亞分享經歷並勸各人不要像他，更帶領眾男接受戒除食軟飯的毒癮，且替他們重組債務。靜雯懷孕後身體常感不適，容材與費柴故意讓靜雯看到拉美吻在野。芭芭拉派飯盒給露宿者時看見尤田，想拉尤田回家但被拒。尤田患感冒，病榻中想到要向在野報仇。公開活動上，拉美向靜雯表示已與在野在一起，尤田突然持刀出現割傷自己的手指，與在場多人同時暈倒。尤田在醫院醒來，照顧他的醫護人員卻暈倒。

programme.title: 高朋滿座#223粵
programme.desc: 情人節將至，悅相約朋到戲院看戲，朋爽快答應會購票。二人回到飯廳，看到義與花在大曬恩愛，義即取笑沒有愛侶的情。與此同時，亨帶麗到高級餐廳進膳，可惜麗卻不解溫柔，強拉亨到大拍檔用餐，亨一怒而去。

programme.title: 玉樓春#37粵普PG
programme.desc: 有德繼續憶述與無雙再相遇後相戀的過程，可惜本欲私奔的兩人最終被孫遜棒打鴛鴦。孫母見如今有德已分家，不想女兒再遭李家害命，決定成全兩人。昭和長公主因玉樓相救，請旨要嫁他，玉樓沒有拒絕，更寫下休書給少春。

programme.title: 美女廚房粵
programme.desc: 今集指定菜式「荔枝鴨胸配印度薄餅」，步驟不繁複，黎諾懿、鄭俊弘、何廣沛該不用擔心太多吧！有美女為搶分怪招盡出，行「跌膊」政策是否奏效？誠實地說出鴨胸未熟透，誠意能打動評判嗎？自選菜式主題為示愛餐，一隻斑馬瀨尿蝦，有美女一斬便流失蝦膏精華，自取滅亡！另外兩位用鹹蛋炒、鹽焗烹煮，好味到阿Bob連蝦殼都食埋，振朗則不停問二女是否單身。地獄菜式換來負評不斷，唯獨何廣沛給予無限高的分數，難道這美女示愛成功？

programme.title: 絕妙的遺產
programme.desc: 【拒分遺產！為教訓貪財不孝子老父親再婚年輕單親媽】80歲的老闆夫英培，經營50年歷史的平壤冷麵老店，在一次睡夢中偶然靈魂出竅，4名兒子誤以為父親死亡，正在房外討論著如何分配爸爸的遺產。看著這些不成材的兒子們只想著財產，令夫英培非常痛心，醒來後打算將財產全數捐出，不料遭到基金會拒收。在一次偶然事件中，與30歲的單親媽媽孔桂玉相遇，並打算在兒子面前上演假結婚，當桂玉正式成為繼母後，兒子們慌了手腳，經過朝夕相處後，一家人克服了偏見，兒子們也不再覬覦遺產，而重新找回人生方向。

programme.title: 熱血軍檢
programme.desc: 【安普賢攜手曹寶兒，成最強軍檢察官搭檔！！】以韓國軍事法庭為背景，為了各自目的而成為軍檢察官，都培萬只想往上爬達成復仇目標，車友仁出身軍法世家，為替父母討回公道而回到軍中。當軍中黑暗勢力浮上檯面，他們選擇不再服從命令，而是直面權力、揭露真相。在正義與復仇之間，兩人逐步找回真正的信念，也點燃危險又炙熱的同盟關係，從對立到並肩作戰的故事。

programme.title: 南風知我意
programme.desc: 【《蓮花樓》成毅在搭張予曦，再現《與君歌》絕美默契！！】藥物研發員傅雲深與外科醫生朱舊至偏鄉進行人道醫療救援，兩人從誤解到經歷生死危機而兩情相悅，彼此還不及坦承心意就遭逢巨變，從此斷絕聯繫。一年後的重逢，面對傅雲深的刁難與變化，朱舊堅韌及樂觀並不離不棄的守候，陪他度過每個春夏秋冬。

programme.title: 兩個女人的房間(完)
programme.desc: 【慘遭閨蜜心機暗算朴恩惠由飯店繼承人淪為女僕】在瑞士留學歸來後，晴彩充滿自信地踏入了蒙娜麗莎飯店，端莊秀麗的外表和聰穎的頭腦，讓她很快成為了飯店的副社長兼繼承人。與同飯店的總經理志燮之間的戀情，更是讓她的生活充滿了甜蜜和期待。一場車禍意外將掀起腥風血雨，當晴彩以為自己撞死了熙秀的養父時，內心充滿了恐懼與內疚感，在晴彩的堅持下，熙秀搬進了她的家，開始了新的生活。從那時起，晴彩心愛的人和她的一切都逐漸被熙秀所奪走，包括飯店的地位和財富，晴彩更是從繼承人淪為女僕，為了奪回曾經的一切，晴彩將對熙秀展開復仇。

programme.title: 吹吧微風
programme.desc: 【千億遺產考驗林智妍淪落魄千金竟遭林秀香假冒身分】一場跨越南北的失散命運，意外揭開千億財產背後的血緣騙局。脫北女孩微風重返南韓，與多年不見的初戀律師長高重逢，卻被捲入豪門爭產與身世之謎。冒名孫女設局奪產，謊言層層堆疊，親情逐漸崩裂；長高的母親強勢介入，以門第與前途逼迫兒子放棄真愛。當真相一一曝光，有人為貪念付出慘痛代價，有人失去一切。被犧牲的愛情，是否還能在命運翻轉後，迎來真正的團圓？

programme.title: 魔女之城
programme.desc: 【婆媳小姑撕破臉！命運抓弄下的同居奇蹟】一場毀滅性的家庭變故，讓原本關係緊繃的離婚婆婆、媳婦與小姑，命運交織地被迫同住在一個屋簷下。撕下以往的對立標籤，三個性格迥異、傷痕累累的女人在滿是摩擦與衝突的日常中，漸漸看清彼此的脆弱。她們相互扶持、攜手抵禦人生的逆境風浪，最終走出陰霾，共築出比血緣更堅固的暖心情誼！

programme.desc: 【安普賢攜手曹寶兒，成最強軍檢察官搭檔！！】以韓國軍事法庭為背景，為了各自目的而成為軍檢察官，都培萬只想往上爬達成復仇目標，車友仁出身軍法世家，為替父母討回公道而回到軍中。當軍中黑暗勢力浮上檯面，他們選擇不再服從命令，而是直面權力、揭露真相。在正義與復仇之間，兩人逐步找回真正的信念，也點燃危險又炙熱的同盟關係，從對立到並肩作戰的故事。

programme.title: 魔女之城
programme.desc: 【婆媳小姑撕破臉！命運抓弄下的同居奇蹟】一場毀滅性的家庭變故，讓原本關係緊繃的離婚婆婆、媳婦與小姑，命運交織地被迫同住在一個屋簷下。撕下以往的對立標籤，三個性格迥異、傷痕累累的女人在滿是摩擦與衝突的日常中，漸漸看清彼此的脆弱。她們相互扶持、攜手抵禦人生的逆境風浪，最終走出陰霾，共築出比血緣更堅固的暖心情誼！

programme.title: 奔跑吧薔薇
programme.desc: 【紈褲子弟情留落難千金，尋覓守護愛情的甜蜜配方】過著豐食無缺沒有大小姐架子的薔薇。一場家中巨變，面臨相親結婚丈夫的背叛，經濟困境及失去原生家庭的後盾。困境中憑著對料理的熱情及新生活，與食品公司會長的孫子相戀，奔向對方的路上還會遇上什麼樣的考驗?

programme.title: 模範刑警
programme.desc: 【孫賢周攜手張勝祖，最強刑警搭檔追查冤案揭開真相！！】資深刑警姜道昌憑經驗與直覺，與只相信證據的天才刑警吳志赫成了新搭檔。兩人辦案風格迥異，從衝突到合作，逐漸建立默契。面對五年前女高中生遇害的案件出現新的疑點，兩人聯手出擊揭開掩蓋的真相，對抗試圖隱瞞冤案的權力與勢力找出真兇。

programme.title: 風起西州
programme.desc: 【《風起霓裳》最新續作！！許魏洲、古力娜扎續夫妻情緣，琴瑟和鳴的婚後生活及事業新考驗！！】製衣才女庫狄琉璃與裴行儉婚後面對大長公主的屢次使計刁難，琉璃聰慧應對，化險為夷。裴行儉因意外被貶遠赴西州上任，夫妻攜手同心，琉璃發揮自己的長才，傳授西州百姓製衣技巧。裴行儉則守護西州百姓經濟富足、安居樂業。

programme.title: 奔跑吧薔薇
programme.desc: 【紈褲子弟情留落難千金，尋覓守護愛情的甜蜜配方】過著豐食無缺沒有大小姐架子的薔薇。一場家中巨變，面臨相親結婚丈夫的背叛，經濟困境及失去原生家庭的後盾。困境中憑著對料理的熱情及新生活，與食品公司會長的孫子相戀，奔向對方的路上還會遇上什麼樣的考驗?

programme.title: 時光之城
programme.desc: 【橫跨兩國人氣演員的偶像劇，張哲瀚攜手朴敏英初嘗試愛情羅曼史！！】樂觀積極的元氣少女許真，在前往蓋亞影視應徵時撞見了當紅炸子雞顧持鈞被前女友拒絕的場面。不希望丟臉的事情曝光的顧持鈞則從中作梗想趕走許真，卻陰錯陽差的在蓋亞集團二公子林晉修的幫助下，反而成為了顧持鈞的助理。朝夕相處、情愫蔓延，卻同時捲入了集團的陰謀，兩人要如何逃出危機，讓有情人終成眷屬呢?

programme.title: 絕妙的遺產
programme.desc: 【拒分遺產！為教訓貪財不孝子老父親再婚年輕單親媽】80歲的老闆夫英培，經營50年歷史的平壤冷麵老店，在一次睡夢中偶然靈魂出竅，4名兒子誤以為父親死亡，正在房外討論著如何分配爸爸的遺產。看著這些不成材的兒子們只想著財產，令夫英培非常痛心，醒來後打算將財產全數捐出，不料遭到基金會拒收。在一次偶然事件中，與30歲的單親媽媽孔桂玉相遇，並打算在兒子面前上演假結婚，當桂玉正式成為繼母後，兒子們慌了手腳，經過朝夕相處後，一家人克服了偏見，兒子們也不再覬覦遺產，而重新找回人生方向。

programme.title: 熱血軍檢
programme.desc: 【安普賢攜手曹寶兒，成最強軍檢察官搭檔！！】以韓國軍事法庭為背景，為了各自目的而成為軍檢察官，都培萬只想往上爬達成復仇目標，車友仁出身軍法世家，為替父母討回公道而回到軍中。當軍中黑暗勢力浮上檯面，他們選擇不再服從命令，而是直面權力、揭露真相。在正義與復仇之間，兩人逐步找回真正的信念，也點燃危險又炙熱的同盟關係，從對立到並肩作戰的故事。

programme.title: 南風知我意
programme.desc: 【《蓮花樓》成毅在搭張予曦，再現《與君歌》絕美默契！！】藥物研發員傅雲深與外科醫生朱舊至偏鄉進行人道醫療救援，兩人從誤解到經歷生死危機而兩情相悅，彼此還不及坦承心意就遭逢巨變，從此斷絕聯繫。一年後的重逢，面對傅雲深的刁難與變化，朱舊堅韌及樂觀並不離不棄的守候，陪他度過每個春夏秋冬。

programme.title: 吹吧微風
programme.desc: 【千億遺產考驗林智妍淪落魄千金竟遭林秀香假冒身分】一場跨越南北的失散命運，意外揭開千億財產背後的血緣騙局。脫北女孩微風重返南韓，與多年不見的初戀律師長高重逢，卻被捲入豪門爭產與身世之謎。冒名孫女設局奪產，謊言層層堆疊，親情逐漸崩裂；長高的母親強勢介入，以門第與前途逼迫兒子放棄真愛。當真相一一曝光，有人為貪念付出慘痛代價，有人失去一切。被犧牲的愛情，是否還能在命運翻轉後，迎來真正的團圓？

programme.title: 魔女之城
programme.desc: 【婆媳小姑撕破臉！命運抓弄下的同居奇蹟】一場毀滅性的家庭變故，讓原本關係緊繃的離婚婆婆、媳婦與小姑，命運交織地被迫同住在一個屋簷下。撕下以往的對立標籤，三個性格迥異、傷痕累累的女人在滿是摩擦與衝突的日常中，漸漸看清彼此的脆弱。她們相互扶持、攜手抵禦人生的逆境風浪，最終走出陰霾，共築出比血緣更堅固的暖心情誼！

programme.title: 奔跑吧薔薇
programme.desc: 【紈褲子弟情留落難千金，尋覓守護愛情的甜蜜配方】過著豐食無缺沒有大小姐架子的薔薇。一場家中巨變，面臨相親結婚丈夫的背叛，經濟困境及失去原生家庭的後盾。困境中憑著對料理的熱情及新生活，與食品公司會長的孫子相戀，奔向對方的路上還會遇上什麼樣的考驗?

programme.title: 模範刑警(完)
programme.desc: 【孫賢周攜手張勝祖，最強刑警搭檔追查冤案揭開真相！！】資深刑警姜道昌憑經驗與直覺，與只相信證據的天才刑警吳志赫成了新搭檔。兩人辦案風格迥異，從衝突到合作，逐漸建立默契。面對五年前女高中生遇害的案件出現新的疑點，兩人聯手出擊揭開掩蓋的真相，對抗試圖隱瞞冤案的權力與勢力找出真兇。

programme.title: 風起西州
programme.desc: 【《風起霓裳》最新續作！！許魏洲、古力娜扎續夫妻情緣，琴瑟和鳴的婚後生活及事業新考驗！！】製衣才女庫狄琉璃與裴行儉婚後面對大長公主的屢次使計刁難，琉璃聰慧應對，化險為夷。裴行儉因意外被貶遠赴西州上任，夫妻攜手同心，琉璃發揮自己的長才，傳授西州百姓製衣技巧。裴行儉則守護西州百姓經濟富足、安居樂業。

programme.title: 奔跑吧薔薇
programme.desc: 【紈褲子弟情留落難千金，尋覓守護愛情的甜蜜配方】過著豐食無缺沒有大小姐架子的薔薇。一場家中巨變，面臨相親結婚丈夫的背叛，經濟困境及失去原生家庭的後盾。困境中憑著對料理的熱情及新生活，與食品公司會長的孫子相戀，奔向對方的路上還會遇上什麼樣的考驗?

programme.title: 時光之城
programme.desc: 【橫跨兩國人氣演員的偶像劇，張哲瀚攜手朴敏英初嘗試愛情羅曼史！！】樂觀積極的元氣少女許真，在前往蓋亞影視應徵時撞見了當紅炸子雞顧持鈞被前女友拒絕的場面。不希望丟臉的事情曝光的顧持鈞則從中作梗想趕走許真，卻陰錯陽差的在蓋亞集團二公子林晉修的幫助下，反而成為了顧持鈞的助理。朝夕相處、情愫蔓延，卻同時捲入了集團的陰謀，兩人要如何逃出危機，讓有情人終成眷屬呢?

programme.title: 模範刑警(完)
programme.desc: 【孫賢周攜手張勝祖，最強刑警搭檔追查冤案揭開真相！！】資深刑警姜道昌憑經驗與直覺，與只相信證據的天才刑警吳志赫成了新搭檔。兩人辦案風格迥異，從衝突到合作，逐漸建立默契。面對五年前女高中生遇害的案件出現新的疑點，兩人聯手出擊揭開掩蓋的真相，對抗試圖隱瞞冤案的權力與勢力找出真兇。

programme.desc: 【高雅羅×金明洙×成東鎰，三人三色法官個性，尋找法庭正義！！】三位個性截然不同的法官，在現實與理想間的掙扎與選擇。熱血直率的新任法官及冷靜理性的資深法官同事。每一場審判，都是對人性與制度的考驗。在案件背後，他們不只判案，更在學習如何面對自己心中的「正義」。

programme.desc: 9-year-old Roman follows his mother Oksana, an illegal nurse in Germany. Oksana falls in love with 62-year-old Gert who tries to befriend Roman. While spending an afternoon alone with Roman, Gert suddenly dies of a heart attack, leaving Roman alone.

programme.title: Heavenly Nomadic
programme.desc: A family of nomads dwelling high in the mountains of Kyrgyzstan doesn't need any of the conveniences of modern civilization in order to be happy. But progress is creeping into their lives regardless, destroying legends and traditions as it comes.

programme.title: Hippocrates
programme.desc: Benjamin dreams of being a great doctor, but his internship at his father’s ward doesn’t turn out the way he hoped. His experience as a junior doctor, with its overwhelming responsibility and stiff competition, forces him to confront his limits and fears.

programme.title: Masha
programme.desc: Masha has grown up between the boxing ring and the streets of her provincial Russian town. Her closest friends, young gangsters who are loathed by the entire town, love and protect her. And suddenly the cruel truth about them is revealed to her.

programme.title: Empty Nets
programme.desc: Amir loves Narges and Narges loves Amir. But their hopes and dreams for a life together collide head on with the web of tradition, corruption, and social hierarchy that continues to rule over the lives of a new generation in Iran.

programme.title: A Tale of Samurai Cooking - A True Love Story
programme.desc: Great cook Haru has married into the legendary “Kitchen Samurai” family. But her husband who is the successor of the Funaki family cannot cook at all. Haru makes a vow to make him a superb samurai chef and starts teaching her new husband how to cook.

programme.title: Mountain Woman
programme.desc: When famine overruns a small Japanese village, Rin must leave the village in order to protect her father accused of theft. Rin heads deep into Mt. Hayachin, and crosses the forbidden mountain god's shrine, where the goddess of thieves is said to dwell.

programme.title: Paralympian
programme.desc: Inspired by true stories. The one leg athlete sinks into a deep depression, until one day he is offered to try his luck at the Paralympic games.

programme.title: Train Driver's Diary
programme.desc: As Ilija nears retirement, his record of unintentional deaths as a train driver weighs heavy. His adopted son, Sima, fears following in his footsteps. But as days pass without incident, Ilija's determination to ensure Sima's success takes a dark turn.

programme.title: Sarah Kohr: Cement
programme.desc: After waking in a hospital with no memory, Sarah Kohr is accused of shooting an innocent man following a violent accident. Determined to clear her name, she sets out to uncover the truth of what really happened that night.

programme.title: Tuesday Club
programme.desc: Karin's world crumbles on her 40th anniversary when she discovers her husband’s infidelity. Seeking solace in a cooking class with renowned chef Henrik, she rediscovers her lifelong passions and learns that it is never too late to follow her dreams.

programme.title: Top Dogs
programme.desc: A dramedy about two estranged brothers from Normandy. Antoine is happily married with two kids and a successful boat driver, whereas Christian is a globe-trotting hustler. When Antoine becomes involved in sleazy activities, Christian comes to his rescue.

programme.desc: Jacqueline adopts two children from a foreign country with her husband. To help with translation, the kids are accompanied by Gabriele, a twenty-year old who is just starting to taste the sweetness of feeling power.

programme.title: Sarah Kohr: Cement
programme.desc: After waking in a hospital with no memory, Sarah Kohr is accused of shooting an innocent man following a violent accident. Determined to clear her name, she sets out to uncover the truth of what really happened that night.

programme.title: Running On Sand
programme.desc: When an Eritrean refugee about to be deported from Israel is mistaken for the Nigerian striker just signed to a struggling soccer team, his fate depends on the team’s success in this charming, socially relevant dramedy.

programme.title: Tuesday Club

programme.title: All The Songs We Never Sang
programme.desc: Rebellious teen Natsumi ventures from Tokyo to a small island to meet her aunt and learn the art of pearl diving (but secretly to find a treasure she was told about as a child).

programme.title: Top Dogs
programme.desc: A dramedy about two estranged brothers from Normandy. Antoine is happily married with two kids and a successful boat driver, whereas Christian is a globe-trotting hustler. When Antoine becomes involved in sleazy activities, Christian comes to his rescue.

programme.title: Lightning-Struck
programme.desc: At her wedding in the Auvergne mountains, Lucie survives a lightning strike that kills her husband but leaves her with the ability to remember every moment of her life. At a reunion two years later, the survivors are targeted by a mysterious killer.

programme.title: Milk Teeth
programme.desc: Living in a small rural community, Skalde navigates societal stigma due to having an “outsider” mother. When she befriends a mysterious girl in the woods, Skalde jeopardizes everything, struggling to balance loyalty to her community and her newfound bond.

programme.title: What's for Dinner, Mom?
programme.desc: Sisters Tae and Yo return to their childhood home and discover a box of recipes and letters from their late Japanese mother. As Tae uncovers her mother’s hidden struggles, she journeys to Taiwan to retrace her past through memory and food.

programme.title: Ladies Item
programme.desc: A young boy hustles through crowded trains, racing against time to buy a tricycle for his disabled father figure, risking everything in his desperate quest to change their fate.

programme.title: Elaha
programme.desc: Elaha, a young Kurdish-German woman, battles patriarchy and family expectations while seeking her own path. Elaha struggles with traditions, marriage and virginity, and she must choose between emancipation or delusion.

programme.title: Yakka Dee S03 - Drum

The journey is repeated with some special surprises along the way and everyone has a boogie when Dee's friend finally succeeds in saying today's word!

programme.title: Mojo Swoptops S01 - The Way of the Woods

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Surprise! - Bluey special trilogy episode 3

programme.desc: Cap'n Gail's tall tale of a nine-legged octopus in Lake Swoppiton has everyone panicking. But Mojo and Bo wonder: is the story real, or is Cap'n Gail up to something?

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Bedroom
programme.desc: Bluey is excited to get her own room. But when bed time comes, she misses Bingo more than she expected and must find a way to stay in touch with her sister.

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Surprise! - Bluey special trilogy episode 3
programme.desc: Bluey and Bingo want dad to play two different games, so dad tries to play both at the same time. While also watching the race on TV.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S05 - The In Charge Badge
programme.desc: What are the rules about being in charge? Make a plan, keep everyone happy, make decisions, lead by example and listen. Roly takes that one so seriously he gets a bit overwhelmed.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S05 - The World Record
programme.desc: The Squirrels want to get a World Record, but in what? And Duggee is too busy to help. "If only we had more Duggee's" muses Tag. Which gives Norrie a record-breaking idea...

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club S01 - Ping Pong Penguins
programme.desc: What’s that bouncy, pingy, whacking sound? It’s the Penguins playing ping-pong!

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club S01 - Splash Dash
programme.desc: Duggie chooses a key and his blue digger to dig up a big bone. The chipmunk makes a delivery to the squirrels.

programme.title: Go Jetters S03 - Shopping Shenanigans, Istanbul, Turkey
programme.desc: In Istanbul's Grand Bazaar, Glitch wishes he could buy everything. Hearing about the wishes granted by the Hen's Eye Column in an underground water store, the Basilica Cistern, Glitch heads beneath the earth and brings the entire cistern close to collapse!

programme.title: Bluey S01 - Backpackers
programme.desc: Mum and Dad are going on an adventure wearing the kids as their cheeky backpacks! Seeing the sights and buying street food, backpacking is a blast - until they lose their passports.

programme.title: Bluey S02 - Easter
programme.desc: It's the night before Easter and Bluey and Bingo are worried the Easter bunny is going to forget about them like last year. Mum and Dad reassure the girls but when they wake up to no chocolate eggs, Bingo fears the worst. Luckily Bluey finds a series of clues and a treasure hunt throughout the house begins.

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Pass the Parcel
programme.desc: Lucky's Dad is outraged that modern Pass the Parcel has a present in every layer and changes the rules back to only having one prize in the middle, but Bingo is forever losing.

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Perfect
programme.desc: For her Father's Day card, Bluey sets out to draw a picture of herself and her father together. While recalling her favourite memories of playing with Bandit, Bluey struggles with the idea that her drawing must be perfect. Chilli tries to convince Bluey that perfection isn't easy, or absolutely necessary.

programme.title: Andy's Dino Island S01 - Andy and the Dino Poop
programme.desc: Jen is studying the poop of different dinosaurs on the island, so Andy heads out on an epic adventure to collect some samples. Along the way, he meets an Alamosaurus.

programme.title: Playtime Towers S01 - Bubbles
programme.desc: Bella and Lift have fun blowing and popping bubbles. In the Cloud Kitchen, all the bubbles give Patch an idea for a tasty treat - blast off melon rockets!

programme.title: Hey Duggee S02 - The Theatre Badge
programme.desc: Tino and Eugene are having a disagreement about an amateur dramatic show they want to put on. One wants an all singing all dancing extravaganza while the other, a serious drama. Can Duggee and the squirrels help them get something ready to perform?

programme.title: Hey Duggee S02 - The Shadow Badge
programme.desc: The sun is setting, and the squirrels are sitting on the sofa. They've had a very busy day. Suddenly all the lights go out! POP! Oh dear, there's been a power cut. The squirrels can't see anything! Thanks, goodness Duggee has got his torch, and he has torches for everyone.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S02 - The Collecting Badge
programme.desc: Duggee is cleaning his biscuit tin collection, one of the many things he collects. The squirrels are inspired to make their own collections. They busy themselves doing the collecting bit, and then display their precious things in the clubhouse.

programme.title: Go Jetters S02 - Gliding, Argentina
programme.desc: The Go Jet cadets are taking to the skies in Argentina in an attempt to pass their academy gliding test. As gliders do not have engines, Xuli is teaching two other pilot cadets how to glide using thermals to keep them up in the air. Not wanting to miss out on the aerial action, Grandmaster Glitch gatecrashes the flying lesson in his Grim Glider! Not only has his glider got an engine, but he also wants to make the lesson into a race. Not cool...

programme.title: Go Jetters S02 - Valley Of The Balls, Kazakhstan
programme.desc: The Go Jetters travel to the Valley of Balls in Kazakhstan, where they find thousands of rocks which are almost perfectly round. Meanwhile, Grandmaster Glitch is seeking the ideal ball to use to practise his bowling - something big and heavy. What could be better then one of the giant balls of rock from the Valley of Balls? But things start to go wrong for the Grandmaster when he rolls the ball of rock right out of Grim HQ and straight towards an unsuspecting group of tourists. The Go Jetters ta

programme.title: Thomas & Friends S24 - Thomas' Fuzzy Friend
programme.desc: Thomas befriends a stray dog who is wandering around the railway and tries to find him a home. In the process, Thomas derails and the fuzzy little dog raises the alarm.

programme.title: Nikhil & Jay S01 - Nikhil and Jay and the Monster Camp
programme.desc: When Jay discovers Nikhil had camped in the wild, he wants to have a monster camping adventure in their garden. Will they meet any monsters? And will Jay be as brave as Nikhil?

programme.title: Stan Can S01 - Bug Hotel
programme.desc: Benjamin and Sophie have a new bug friend. Stanley helps build a bug feeder which attracts lots more bugs. They eat so much; Stanley gets more food and builds a Bug Hotel for them.

programme.title: Stan Can S01 - Recycling
programme.desc: Fred, Fifi and Ari call Stanley to help them with their recycling drive by coming up with a way of repurposing all the towns' old stuff. Stanley makes a crazy golf course!

programme.title: Funny Talking Animals S01 - I Like Tractors
programme.desc: From riding cows to having pigs in the house, the funny animals chat about everything brilliant about farms.

programme.title: JoJo & Gran Gran S01 - It's time for a birthday party
programme.desc: When JoJo learns that Jared was too busy to have a birthday party, Gran Gran has a Gran Gran Plan to throw Jared a surprise belated birthday party!

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Dragon
programme.desc: When Bluey needs some assistance drawing a dragon for a story she is working on, she asks her dad, Bandit, for help.

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Wild Girls
programme.desc: Coco wants to play Wild Girls with Indy, but Chloe wants her to play another game.

programme.title: Bluey S03 - TV Shop
programme.desc: At the chemist, Bluey and Bingo have fun playing with the CCTV screens.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S02 - The Colour Badge
programme.desc: Duggee is painting in his favourite colouring book, and the Squirrels want to join in.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S02 - The Harvest Badge
programme.desc: Duggee is getting ready to harvest the ripe crops that grown. The squirrels remember when they planted their seeds, watered them, and left them to grow, and now it's time to help Duggee pick them all.

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club S01 - Squirrel Babies
programme.desc: Spring has sprung! There are cute baby animals to meet and frolic with, Hennie bounces around in new dance shoes, and Happy loves water as much as Roly loves potatoes!

programme.title: My Friend Maisy S01 - Shopping
programme.desc: Maisy goes shopping for groceries, but forgets what was on her shopping list.

programme.title: My Friend Maisy S01 - Ambulance
programme.desc: Maisy and Charley help Eddie in their ambulance.

programme.title: Roots & Fruits S01 - Lemon
programme.desc: Lemon performs a stand-up routine!

programme.title: Roots & Fruits S01 - Carrot
programme.desc: Carrot sings about being trendy.

programme.title: Supertato S01 - Carrot the Champion
programme.desc: Evil Pea captures Supertato, but Carrot masters the ultimate flip kick and rescues her.

programme.title: Supertato S01 - Wonder Pea
programme.desc: Evil Pea tricks Supertato by pretending to be his sidekick and captures him instead.

programme.title: Teletubbies S01 - King
programme.desc: In Teletubbyland, Dipsy is King. Tinky Winky delivers Tubby Custard and Tubby Toast to King Dipsy - whatever King Dipsy wants! Luckily for Tinky Winky they soon swap places.

programme.title: What Price Honesty
programme.desc: Three rookie constables refuse to collude with corrupt officials, making themselves targets of a deadly conspiracy. After losing comrades and witnessing the abuse of power, they abandon all hope of justice. Determined to avenge the fallen, they launch a bloody assault on the corrupt forces in a desperate fight for justice.

programme.title: The Big Sting
programme.desc: Three buddies find a rare artifact known as the Double-Faced God but are poisoned by Lady Wu who steals the treasure from them. Before they die, they get their wives to promise to train their children to take back what is rightfully theirs. These kids grow up to exact a vengeance that turns out to be more hilarious than horrific in this comedy.

programme.title: The Eight Diagram Pole Fighter
programme.desc: The Yang Generals were ambushed by the enemies and only two of the sons survived. The fifth son of Yang's escapes to Shaolin temple and learns the pole-fighting techniques from the monks, eventually creating his own “Eight Diagram Pole Fight” and teaming up with the Shaolin monks to avenge his family.

programme.title: The Reckless Cricket
programme.desc: Inspired by “Drunken Master”, this kung fu comedy features a bumbling martial artist creating a cricket-style fighting arts to fight and defeat the different martial artists who have beaten him before.

programme.title: The Last Tempest
programme.desc: This sequel to The Empress Dowager continues the tale of Emperor Guangxu and Empress Dowager Cixi. Despite Guangxu's enthronement, his ability to rule effectively is overshadowed by the ever-present power of Cixi. When his attempts to reform the Imperial system are thwarted by the Empress Dowager, Guangxu attempts to curb her power.

programme.title: The Chinese Boxer
programme.desc: A Japanese karate master and Diao Er, who has been expelled from his martial arts school, return to the school to kill the school master and his disciples. After the massacre, disciple Lei Ming embarks on a vigorous training regime and vows to avenge their deaths. A fatal battle is about to begin...

programme.title: The Crazy Bumpkins
programme.desc: This side-splitting comedy sees naive Ah Niu headed to Hong Kong, where he is repeatedly exploited and taken advantage of, and eventually finds himself arrested and imprisoned! Can he survive difficult times and finally overcome adversity?

programme.title: The Iron Buddha
programme.desc: After a notorious rapist Xiao kills his master and the entire clan, Han the last surviving disciple, decides to take revenge. He must find the legendary Hulong Blade to counter Xiao's Evil Poisonous Sword, but as Han has never seen Xiao before, he is deceived when Xiao poses as an ally to try and steal his Blade in the process.

programme.title: The Shadow Boxing
programme.desc: Chan and his apprentice Fan transport zombies for a living and are hired to move nine zombies in one go. When two hop away, it is revealed that one is actually a man in disguise trying to escape his enemies. It turns out that both the disguised zombie and Chan are martial arts experts!

programme.title: Sons Of Good Earth
programme.desc: This is an epic tale set during the time of the Sino-Japanese war. A painter Yu saves a young girl, Lotus, who is being sold to a brothel. They fall in love, get married and settled in to a peaceful life. However, their life is soon shattered by the Japanese invasion and the brutal regime that follows...

programme.title: Love without End(1961)
programme.desc: In this classic romantic melodrama, nightclub songstress Qing Qing falls for the handsome Peng Nan. However, the two go through an emotional roller coaster of misunderstandings, separations and mutual torment. When the two finally fall back into love, Qing Qing receives a shocking revelation that brings the story to its inevitable sad ending.

programme.title: Twelve Deadly Coins
programme.desc: When Qiao Miao is about to kill the bandit whom he just met, he is attracted by her beauty and they quickly fall in love. The two later discover the blood feud between the owner of the unique weapon - “Twelve Deadly Coins” and the old master who controls the bandit...

programme.title: Spring Blossoms
programme.desc: Some of Shaw Brothers' biggest female stars of the 1970s share the screen in this tale of young love and interfering parents, starring Lily Li, Shu Pei Pei and Essie Lin Chia.

programme.title: Man Of Iron
programme.desc: A fearless fighter, Chou Lian Huan has risen to power in Shanghai with his exceptional combat skills. He risks his life for hostess Shen Ju Fang and embarks on a series of fierce battles against the son of a notorious triad leader and his gang, ultimately becoming a scapegoat in the gang's deadly turf war.

programme.title: Hex
programme.desc: This supernatural mystery tells the story of a sickly wife and her maid conspiring to kill her beastly husband, leading to a string of events with spooky twists and turns.

programme.title: Hex
programme.desc: This supernatural mystery tells the story of a sickly wife and her maid conspiring to kill her beastly husband, leading to a string of events with spooky twists and turns.

programme.title: The Bells of Death
programme.desc: Wei Fu is an unremarkable woodcutter. However, when psychotic marauders killed his family and abducted his sister, he goes through vigorous martial arts training with an expert swordsman in order to exact revenge on the evildoers.

programme.title: Hex Vs Witchcraft
programme.desc: A compulsive gambler with bad luck owes money to a violent gangster boss and trades his wife as down payment, causing her to leave him. As he decides to kill himself, a mysterious old man offers him a proposal to marry the ghost of his dead daughter in exchange for cash and an expensive apartment.

programme.title: Vengeance is a Golden Blade
programme.desc: Convoy Master Li's wife has an affair with his rival Long, who plans to steal Li's Golden Blade and kill him as well as his young daughter. Li and his daughter manage to escape and the latter grows up to be a skilled swordswoman who vows to avenge her mother's death-a lie told by Li. The truth is revealed when she sees her mother alive by chance.

programme.title: My Son
programme.desc: Kuo, a police's son, blames his father for his mother's death. He has no job, spends time in night clubs and always gets into fights. One night, Kuo rescues Mei from being raped and they become friends. Kuo wants to support Mei and her family so he goes gambling hoping to gain more money but bad luck seems to be following them with tragic outcomes.

programme.title: The Proud Youth
programme.desc: Ling Hu Chong, a Huashan clan's disciple, is assigned to find the successor to the score “The Proud One”. Ling identifies Ying for the score but finds out that she is the daughter of the evil clan's leader. At the same time, he is unwittingly dragged into an epic power struggle between clans, with complicated allegiances and perplexing moralities.

programme.title: Diary of a Lady-killer
programme.desc: Tycoon Zhou is a playboy who is engaged to be married, but that did not keep him from working his charms on as many ladies as he can. He keeps a diary about his romantic escapades and soon, the women with whom he has been intimate with are being murdered one by one. Zhou becomes the number one suspect by the police but is the killer someone else?

programme.title: Shaolin Prince
programme.desc: Two royal brothers are separated as babies after a traitorous general usurps the throne. Raised apart, one within Shaolin Temple and the other by a noble lord, they grow into formidable martial artists. When destiny reunites them, the brothers must combine their deadly kung fu styles to overthrow the tyrant and avenge their fallen empire.

programme.title: The Brave Archer 2
programme.desc: Knowing Guo Jing has won Huang Rong's hand in marriage using the kung fu learned from Jiu Yin manual, Ouyang Feng captures Huang and agrees to release her only if Guo can dictate the content of the manual. Will Guo give in to the threat?

programme.title: Have Sword Will Travel
programme.desc: When the head of a manor loses his kung fu skills, he enlists his nephew and fiancee to escort gold to the capital. Along the way, they encounter a mysterious swordsman and join forces with him to stop bandits from stealing the gold.

programme.title: Tales of Larceny
programme.desc: Connecting all the antics of bosses, monks, beggars, and thieves is the slippery and sinuous efforts of three pickpockets so adept at their chosen skill that they can even trick three beauties of their underwear without missing a step.

programme.title: The Brave Archer
programme.desc: On his way back to the midlands, Guo Jing meets Huang Rong and they quickly fall in love. However, Ouyang Ke proposes to marry Huang Rong at the same time, so Huang's father sets up a duel for the two men to compete for her hand. Guo Jing finally beats Ouyang Ke to win Huang Rong back.

programme.title: The Butterfly Chalice
programme.desc: In the Ming Dynasty, scholar Tian Yu Chuan defends a fisherman's honour but accidentally kills the governor's son, driving him into exile. Pursued to the river's edge, he is rescued by the fisherman's daughter. Amid danger, love blossoms between them, and Tian seals their bond with his family heirloom, the Butterfly Chalice.

programme.title: Trilogy Of Swordsmanship
programme.desc: A kung fu anthology film consisting of three stories: a man embarrasses himself while trying to prove his worth to the father of the woman he loves; a courtesan in love with a general will need to deliver a notorious bandit in exchange for him not being executed; and a group of bandits forms a plan to rescue a new friend from being executed.

programme.title: The Bride from Hell
programme.desc: Fang Ming marries the mysterious young lady Leng Qiu Ping, only to discover she is a spirit forced to drain men's life essence. With a Taoist's help, he frees her from an evil force, but their love cannot cross life and death, and they part at dawn in a bittersweet farewell.

programme.title: The Bride from Hell
programme.desc: Fang Ming marries the mysterious young lady Leng Qiu Ping, only to discover she is a spirit forced to drain men's life essence. With a Taoist's help, he frees her from an evil force, but their love cannot cross life and death, and they part at dawn in a bittersweet farewell.

programme.title: The Convict Killer
programme.desc: After spending fifteen years in prison on trumped-up charges for drug smuggling, the martial arts master Teng Piao embarks on a journey to take revenge on the person who sets him up - “Black Leopard”. Unfortunately for Piao, no one knows the real identity of “Black Leopard”, except that there is a black leopard tattoo on his chest.

programme.title: Torrent Of Desire
programme.desc: Rich playboy David is a drunk until he falls in love with a fashion model Dan Feng and marries her. David's sister Mona is in love with his best friend Han Ming, who rejected her as he secretly loves Dan Feng as well. Out of jealousy and hatred, Mona lies to David about a fake affair between Han Ming and Dan Feng...

programme.title: The Swift Knight
programme.desc: The Ming Emperor is dying with no heir to succeed the throne. His brother recalls that he has an illegitimate child with a court lady years ago and palace guards are sent to search for the heir. When the Emperor's nephew hires assassins to kill the child so he can be the successor, the Swift Knight comes to the rescue...

programme.title: The Adulteress
programme.desc: The film is about the drugged, then disgraced wife of a peddler in the waning days of the Ching Dynasty. To make matters worse, she's soon framed for her husband's murder by her rapist, the son of the local magistrate! And even that is not the end of her woes in this emotional suspense...

programme.title: The Heroic Ones
programme.desc: Set in the Tang Dynasty, the 13 adopted sons of Sha Tuo King are all renowned as royal warriors. David Chiang plays the 13th Prince, a powerful fighter whose prestigious status provokes jealously, leading to a gruesome family feud.

programme.title: The Protectors
programme.desc: Ling Hsiao and Kuan Wang Lung are two guard chiefs working for an old convoy master. Lung is secretly in love with Fang Yen, the master's granddaughter but Yen is attracted to Ling Hsiao instead. In order to win her back, Lung sets up a trap to steal the convoy and frames Ling Hsiao for it.

programme.title: Young Lovers
programme.desc: Guitar-playing rich kid, Yang Fan, heads to Japan to join a rock 'n' roll band where he soon finds himself competing for the affections of two beautiful girls.

programme.title: Mission Impossible
programme.desc: A sword master's daughter is pursued and poisoned by an evil master when bringing back the stolen Golden Sword to the palace. She dies on the run and returns as a spirit to take revenge by killing the evil master, and soon vanishes after returning the sword to the emperor.

programme.title: Melody of Love
programme.desc: Three young doctors pursue three hard-to-get beauties in this romantic film set in the 70s “a-go-go” era. They have no idea where to start and use Rock-paper-scissor method to match themselves with the girls. The tactics and tricks they use are hilarious and they have to reshuffle their plans when nothing leads to success!

programme.title: Chinatown Kid
programme.desc: After getting into trouble with a local gangster, Chui Ho, in Hong Kong, Tam Dong flees to San Francisco and manages to get a job in a restaurant in Chinatown. Tam Dong finds himself embroiled with the gangsters again in San Francisco, and has to fight Chui Ho when the two meet again...

programme.title: The Shepherd Girl
programme.desc: In this musical drama, Hsiu Hsiu, a beautiful shepherd girl, falls in love with a handsome boatman Ta Lung. However, she cannot afford to marry him because of her father's towering debt from gambling. To complicate the matter, a rival suitor promises to pay off all her father's debts on one condition: that Hsiu Hsiu marries him...

programme.title: Danger has Two Faces
programme.desc: Many years ago, Inspector Kam killed an innocent man and decided to resign from the police force. He became a professional killer who disguises as a pet store owner. When his best friend, Bobby begins investigating recent murder cases committed by Kam, he discovers that the mastermind behind these cases is actually his superintendent.

programme.title: Passing Flickers
programme.desc: This film is an amusing insider's look at the Hong Kong film industry and is based on Director Li Han Hsiang's popular newspaper column recounting his work at Shaw Brothers. The collection of some of his funniest and most surreal film musings of the era, filled with behind-the-scene asides, this is a must-see for any Hong Kong cinema aficionado!

programme.title: Ten Tigers of Kwang Tung
programme.desc: The Ten Tigers of Kwang Tung is a group of anti-Ching martial artists who have killed a Ching official. Years later, when five disciples and descendants of Ten Tigers meet one night, one of them is killed by the son of the late Ching official who returns with a vengeance. They must fight against him to protect the Ten Tigers clan...
